paragraphs.en: We introduce 3DCodeVerse , a research ecosystem that enables coding agents to create editable and verifiable 3D content at scale. 3DCodeVerse comprises large-scale, high-quality datasets of executable 3D code, a coding harness for spatial reasoning and automated verification, and practical guidance for 3D coding. First , we construct 3DCodeVerse -2M , a large-scale curated dataset of standalone 3D executable code. We build this corpus by collecting open-source data, converting specialized representations, and generating new programs with coding agents. Each program is packaged with the source files and associated assets required for execution in its declared environment, along with available descriptions and verification records. Second , we develop the 3DCodeVerse Harness , a multi-agent directed acyclic graph framework for generating and refining 3D content. It uses execution checks, spatial measurements, and visual feedback to automatically evaluate and revise generated programs without human feedback during generation. Third , we conduct systematic empirical studies of 3D coding, establishing baselines with fine-tuned open models and deriving practical guidance through component-level analyses of our harness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that fine-tuning on our dataset significantly improves the 3D coding capabilities of open-source models. Notably, our 3DCodeVerse harness achieves a 90% win rate against Claude Design (3D Object) in pairwise human evaluations, when both are utilized by Claude Opus 5.5.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推出了 3DCodeVerse，一个研究生态系统，使编码智能体能够大规模创建可编辑且可验证的 3D 内容。3DCodeVerse 包括大规模、高质量的 3D 可执行代码数据集、用于空间推理和自动验证的编码工具，以及实用的 3D 编码指南。 首先，我们构建了 3DCodeVerse -2M，一个由独立 3D 可执行代码组成的大规模精选数据集。 我们通过收集开源数据、转换专用表示形式，并使用编码智能体生成新程序来构建这个语料库。 每个程序都与其在声明环境中运行所需的源文件和相关资源一起打包，并附有可用的描述和验证记录。 其次，我们开发了 3DCodeVerse 工具，一个用于生成和优化 3D 内容的多智能体有向无环图框架。 它利用执行检查、空间测量和视觉反馈，在生成过程中无需人工反馈即可自动评估和修改生成的程序。 第三，我们对 3D 编码进行了系统的实证研究，通过微调开源模型建立了基准，并通过工具组件级别的分析得出了实用指南。 广泛的实验表明，在我们的数据集上进行微调显著提升了开源模型的 3D 编码能力。 值得注意的是，当两者都由 Claude Opus 5.5 使用时，我们的 3DCodeVerse 工具在成对的人类评估中击败了 Claude Design（3D 对象），胜率达到了 90%。

paragraphs.en: 3D coding offers a promising approach to 3D creation by using executable programs to construct 3D geometry, define articulated motion, compose scenes, and generate graphics effects ( Raistrick et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Unlike typical 2D generation workflows ( Chang et al., 2025 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ) , code-based 3D generation produces structured, executable content that users can edit, reuse, compose, and inspect. These properties enable scalable, controllable 3D modeling for diverse applications. Recent advances in language models and coding agents further automate this process, allowing users to create complex 3D content through text instructions ( Sun et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 3D编码通过利用可执行程序来构建3D几何体、定义铰接运动、组合场景和生成图形效果，为3D创作提供了一种有前景的方法（Raistrick等，2023；Hu等，2024；Zhou等，2026）。 与典型的2D生成工作流程不同（Chang等，2025；Ho等，2020；Yuan等，2025；Yuan等，2024），基于代码的3D生成能够产出结构化的可执行内容，用户可以对这些内容进行编辑、重用、组合和检查。 这些特性使得针对多样化应用的3D建模具备了可扩展性和可控性。 语言模型和编码智能体领域的最新进展进一步自动化了这一过程，让用户能够通过文本指令创建复杂的3D内容（Sun等，2023；Yin等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Despite these advances, shared infrastructure for developing and evaluating 3D coding systems across environments remains limited. Existing resources address complementary aspects of 3D coding: DeepCAD and BlenderLLM provide supervision for CAD construction and Blender scripting ( Wu et al., 2021 ; Du et al., 2024 ) ; SceneCraft and VIGA refine generated content using visual feedback ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2026 ) ; and Articraft combines a specialized SDK with a harness for articulated asset generation ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . However, these resources remain fragmented across tasks and environments. As shown in Table 1 , existing datasets primarily focus on static or articulated objects, while harnesses vary in their support for visual assessment and automated corpus construction.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，但在不同环境中开发并评估三维编码系统的共享基础设施仍然有限。 现有资源涵盖了三维编码的互补方面：DeepCAD 和 BlenderLLM 为 CAD 构建和 Blender 脚本编写提供监督（Wu 等人，2021；Du 等人，2024）；SceneCraft 和 VIGA 利用视觉反馈优化生成内容（Hu 等人，2024；Yin 等人，2026）；而 Articraft 则将专用 SDK 与用于生成可活动资产的框架相结合（Zhou 等人，2026）。 然而，这些资源在不同任务和环境中仍然相互割裂。 如表 1 所示，现有数据集主要关注静态或可活动的对象，而各类框架在支持视觉评估和自动语料构建方面的能力也各不相同。

paragraphs.en: To bridge these gaps, we introduce 3DCodeVerse (Figure 1 ), an open-source foundational framework for learning and scaling 3D coding through a large-scale executable code corpus and a 3D code generation harness. We first build 3DCodeVerse -2M, a unified corpus of executable 3D programs spanning static objects, articulated assets, scenes, and graphics. Rather than simply aggregating existing datasets, we systematically convert heterogeneous 3D representations into reusable source code and remove dependencies on specialized or unavailable libraries. For example, we translate DeepCAD construction sequences into CadQuery programs and inline Articraft geometry routines while preserving URDF articulation specifications. Each program is paired with its associated assets, textual descriptions, provenance, and available verification signals.
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥合这些差距，我们提出了 3DCodeVerse（图 1），这是一个开源的基础框架，旨在通过大规模可执行代码语料库和 3D 代码生成工具，实现 3D 编码的学习与扩展。 我们首先构建了 3DCodeVerse -2M，这是一个统一的可执行 3D 程序语料库，涵盖了静态对象、可动资产、场景和图形。 我们并未简单地聚合现有数据集，而是系统地将异构的 3D 表示转换为可重用的源代码，并消除了对专用或不可用库的依赖。 例如，我们将 DeepCAD 构建序列转换为 CadQuery 程序，并内联 Articraft 几何操作例程，同时保留了 URDF 关节规格。 每个程序都与其相关的资产、文本描述、来源信息以及可用的验证信号一同提供。

paragraphs.en: We further develop 3DCodeVerse Harness, a 3D code generation harness for synthesizing and refining complex 3D programs from text, images, or videos. The harness decomposes multi-component projects into a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of coding and assembly tasks, allowing multiple agents to develop and integrate source files in a structured manner. Generated programs are executed and rendered, after which an independent judge agent evaluates the outputs against explicit acceptance criteria. Complementary spatial checks detect structural inconsistencies and prevent visually plausible but geometrically invalid solutions from receiving high scores. The resulting feedback is then converted into localized repair objectives, enabling repeated execution–evaluation–revision cycles without human intervention. Through this iterative process, the harness supports inference-time scaling to complex projects containing thousands of lines of code.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步开发了 3DCodeVerse Harness，这是一个用于从文本、图像或视频中合成和精炼复杂 3D 程序的三维代码生成工具。 该工具将多组件项目分解为编码与组装任务的有向无环图（DAG），使多个智能体能够以结构化方式开发并整合源文件。 生成的程序会先被执行和渲染，随后由一个独立的评估智能体根据明确的验收标准对输出结果进行评判。 配套的空間检查机制能够检测结构不一致性问题，防止那些在视觉上看似合理但几何上无效的解决方案获得高分。 由此产生的反馈会被转化为局部修复目标，从而实现无需人工干预的重复执行–评估–修订循环。 通过这一迭代过程，该工具支持在推理阶段处理包含数千行代码的复杂项目。

paragraphs.en: Importantly, 3DCodeVerse Harness serves not only as an inference system but also as a data-generation engine. By recording successful programs, failed attempts, targeted repairs, and preference comparisons, its execution traces provide supervision for both supervised fine-tuning and preference learning. Together, 3DCodeVerse -2M and 3DCodeVerse Harness establish not only a reusable infrastructure for 3D coding, but also a closed loop connecting data construction, program synthesis, verification, refinement, and model improvement. We further support this ecosystem with open models and reproducible training recipes. Fine-tuning on 3DCodeVerse -2M substantially improves executable 3D code generation, reaching execution rates of 84.9% with a 9B model and 92.9% with a 27B model on 3DCodeBench . Moreover, 3DCodeVerse Harness consistently improves generation quality across coding agents, yielding gains of 15.5–29.1 points over one-shot generation.
paragraphs.zh: 重要的是，3DCodeVerse Harness 不仅是一个推理系统，也是一个数据生成引擎。 通过记录成功程序、失败尝试、针对性修复和偏好比较，其执行轨迹为监督微调与偏好学习提供了监督依据。 3DCodeVerse -2M 与 3DCodeVerse Harness 共同构建的不仅是一个可重用的 3D 编码基础设施，更是一个连接数据构建、程序合成、验证、优化和模型改进的闭环系统。 我们还通过开放模型和可复现的训练方案进一步支持这一生态系统。 在 3DCodeVerse -2M 上进行微调显著提升了可执行 3D 代码的生成能力，在 3DCodeBench 测试中，9B 模型的执行率达到 84.9%，而 27B 模型则达到 92.9%。 此外，3DCodeVerse Harness 持续提升了各类编码智能体的生成质量，相比单次生成方法，性能提升了 15.5–29.1 分。

paragraphs.en: Learning to generate 3D content as code benefits from supervision over its construction procedures. DeepCAD and Fusion 360 Gallery expose CAD construction sequences, and Text2CAD connects such sequences to natural language ( Wu et al., 2021 ; Willis et al., 2021 ; Khan et al., 2024 ) . This supervision has expanded to executable CadQuery and Blender programs for reconstruction and language-conditioned generation through BlendNet, CAD-Recode, CAD-Coder, and MeshCoder ( Du et al., 2024 ; Rukhovich et al., 2025 ; Guan et al., 2026 ; Dai et al., 2026 ) . Complementary procedural resources broaden the content represented by code: Infinigen and its extensions generate assets and scenes ( Raistrick et al., 2023 ; Raistrick et al., 2024 ; Joshi et al., 2025 ) , while Shaders21k provides programs for procedural image synthesis ( Baradad et al., 2022 ) . Existing benchmarks assess the resulting code generation, editing, and physics capabilities ( Alrashedy et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026b ; Shen et al., 2026 ) . However, our paper focuses on scaling executable supervision across these heterogeneous coding environments. Our 3DCodeVerse-2M provides a million-scale training corpus spanning CAD, Blender, shaders, and browser graphics, with programs that are self-contained within their respective target runtimes. Its construction combines curated existing sources with automated program generation and execution-based filtering, enabling continued data expansion for training open 3D coding models.
paragraphs.zh: 学习以代码形式生成三维内容时，对其构建过程进行监督会大有裨益。 DeepCAD 和 Fusion 360 Gallery 提供了 CAD 构建序列，而 Text2CAD 则将此类序列与自然语言连接起来（Wu 等，2021；Willis 等，2021；Khan 等，2024）。 这种监督方法已扩展至可执行的 CadQuery 和 Blender 程序，通过 BlendNet、CAD-Recode、CAD-Coder 和 MeshCoder 实现了重建与语言条件生成（Du 等，2024；Rukhovich 等，2025；Guan 等，2026；Dai 等，2026）。 互补的过程化资源扩展了代码所能表示的内容：Infinigen 及其扩展能够生成资产和场景（Raistrick 等，2023；Raistrick 等，2024；Joshi 等，2025），而 Shaders21k 则提供了用于过程化图像合成的程序（Baradad 等，2022）。 现有的基准测试评估了由此产生的代码生成、编辑和物理模拟能力（Alrashedy 等，2025；Gu 等，2025；Gao 等，2026b；Shen 等，2026）。 然而，我们的论文重点在于将可执行监督扩展至这些异构的编码环境中。 我们的 3DCodeVerse-2M 提供了一个百万规模的训练语料库，涵盖 CAD、Blender、着色器和浏览器图形，其中的程序在各自的目标运行时环境中自包含。 其构建过程结合了精心挑选的现有资源与自动化的程序生成及基于执行的过滤方法，从而支持持续的数据扩展，以训练开放的三维编码模型。

sents.en: DeepCAD and Fusion 360 Gallery expose CAD construction sequences, and Text2CAD connects such sequences to natural language ( Wu et al., 2021 ; Willis et al., 2021 ; Khan et al., 2024 ) .

sents.en: Its construction combines curated existing sources with automated program generation and execution-based filtering, enabling continued data expansion for training open 3D coding models.

paragraphs.en: Execution and feedback allow 3D coding agents to inspect and revise the content produced by their programs. Systems such as 3D-GPT, SceneCraft, and LL3M establish language-driven planning and program generation for 3D modeling ( Sun et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) . Executing and rendering these programs enables visual refinement, as explored by BlenderAlchemy, CADCodeVerify, and VIGA ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Alrashedy et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2026 ) . Beyond rendered appearance, Articraft provides structured asset validation through a specialized SDK, while Bioinspired123D connects script quality control with a graph-based agentic workflow ( Luu & Buehler, 2026b ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . 3DHarnessBench further studies how the observation and tool interfaces available to an agent affect 3D reconstruction ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, our 3DCodeVerse harness provides a reusable execution and verification framework across coding backends, jointly supporting inference-time refinement and scalable training data curation. Its multi-agent directed acyclic graph coordinates execution, rendering, spatial measurements, and structural checks across static and articulated objects, scenes, and visual effects. The same framework equips coding agents with visual and programmatic feedback and serves as an automated data engine that generates, refines, and filters training programs without human feedback in the curation loop.
paragraphs.zh: 执行与反馈使 3D 编码智能体能够检查并修改其程序生成的内容。 诸如 3D-GPT、SceneCraft 和 LL3M 的系统建立了以语言为驱动力的规划与程序生成机制，用于 3D 建模（Sun et al., 2023；Hu et al., 2024；Lu et al., 2025）。 执行并渲染这些程序可实现视觉优化，BlenderAlchemy、CADCodeVerify 和 VIGA 的研究即体现了这一点（Huang et al., 2024；Alrashedy et al., 2025；Yin et al., 2026）。 除了渲染外观之外，Articraft 通过专用 SDK 提供结构化的资产验证，而 Bioinspired123D 则将脚本质量控制与基于图的智能体工作流程相结合（Luu & Buehler, 2026b；Zhou et al., 2026）。3DHarnessBench 进一步研究了智能体可用的观察与工具接口如何影响 3D 重建（Liu et al., 2026）。 相比之下，我们的 3DCodeVerse 工具包提供了一个可在不同编码后端重复使用的执行与验证框架，共同支持推理阶段的优化和可扩展的训练数据整理。 其多智能体有向无环图协调了静态与可活动对象、场景及视觉效果中的执行、渲染、空间测量和结构检查。 同一框架为编码智能体提供了视觉与程序反馈，并充当自动化数据引擎，能够在数据整理循环中无需人工反馈地生成、优化和筛选训练程序。

paragraphs.en: Data Sources and Composition. Figure 2 shows representative sources; Appendix B.2 summarizes the full collection. Public resources include Bioinspired3D ( Luu & Buehler, 2026a ) , 3DCodeBench ( Gao et al., 2026b ) , Thingiverse, Shadertoy ( Quilez & Jeremias, 2013 ) , CodePen animations (Animation2Code), and multi-file Three.js/React Three Fiber projects. We convert DeepCAD sequences ( Wu et al., 2021 ) and Articraft geometry ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) to CadQuery, retaining Articraft’s URDF. The ProcTHOR ( Deitke et al., 2022 ) subset pairs scene specifications with Blender/Three.js reconstructions. Blender and Three.js coding-agent subsets contribute generated objects and scenes; We further synthesize and archive new programs by running 3DCodeVerse Harness on text and image prompts (§ 4 ).

paragraphs.en: Generating high-quality 3D programs often requires iterative refinement, but reliance on human feedback makes this process difficult to scale. To address this bottleneck, we develop 3DCodeVerse Harness, a multi-agent framework that automates 3D code generation and refinement for data curation and agent-driven content creation (Figure 3 ). It coordinates coding and assembly through a DAG and combines execution checks, spatial tools, and rubric-guided VLM judgments to identify defects and guide targeted revisions without human feedback. Because the reliability of this feedback depends on how we configure its prompts, tools, and rubrics, we further refine the judge and generation workflow through an alternating development-time adversarial loop.
paragraphs.zh: 生成高质量的 3D 程序通常需要迭代优化，但依赖人工反馈使得这一过程难以扩展。 为了解决这一瓶颈，我们开发了 3DCodeVerse Harness——一个多智能体框架，能够自动化 3D 代码的生成与优化，用于数据整理和智能体驱动的内容创作（图 3）。 它通过有向无环图（DAG）协调编码与组装过程，并结合执行检查、空间工具以及基于评分标准的视觉语言模型判断，以识别缺陷并指导针对性修改，无需人工反馈。 由于这种反馈的可靠性取决于提示词、工具和评分标准的配置方式，我们通过交替的开发阶段对抗循环，进一步优化了评判与生成的工作流程。

paragraphs.en: Multi-Agent Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) Framework. Given a condition c c and a target execution environment e e , an LLM planner first produces P = 𝒜 plan ​ ( c , e ) P=\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{plan}}(c;e) , specifying the target components, dimensions, materials, spatial relations, and acceptance criteria. The harness translates P P into a DAG 𝒢 = ( V , E ) \mathcal{G}=(V,E) of coding and assembly tasks, with edges encoding prerequisites. Within this graph, explicit file ownership allows independent coding tasks to be carried out concurrently by sub-agents. Once their prerequisites are satisfied, assembly tasks integrate the resulting code, ultimately producing the initial program f ( 0 ) f^{(0)} for subsequent evaluation and feedback-driven refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体有向无环图（DAG）框架。 给定一个条件 c c 和一个目标执行环境 e e，大型语言模型规划器首先生成 P = 𝒜 plan ​ ( c , e ) P=\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{plan}}(c;e)，其中指定了目标组件、维度、材料、空间关系和验收标准。 该框架将 P P 转换为一个由编码和组装任务构成的有向无环图 𝒢 = ( V , E ) \mathcal{G}=(V,E)，其中的边表示任务的前置条件。 在该图中，明确的文件所有权使得子智能体能够并行执行独立的编码任务。 一旦其前置条件得到满足，组装任务便会整合生成的代码，最终产出初始程序 f ( 0 ) f^{(0)}，用于后续评估和基于反馈的优化。

paragraphs.en: Adversarial Loop Engineering for Harness Optimization. The preceding loop uses automated feedback in place of per-round human inspection and revision guidance. Because this feedback’s reliability depends on how prompts, tools, and rubrics are configured, we alternate between refining the judge and the generation workflow during development. Let θ J \theta_{J} denote the judge’s evidence presentation, rubric, response schema, and aggregation rules, and θ H \theta_{H} the harness’s prompts, contracts, skills, tools, and refinement policy. Judge refinement first fixes the generation workflow and repeatedly evaluates a bank ℬ \mathcal{B} of stored artifacts. Using the same artifacts separates changes in judge behavior from variability in generation. We revise view selection, evidence presentation, and defect checklists, and score aggregation to reduce judgment variability and contradictions with measured evidence. The judge is required to report observations before scores and does not receive the generator’s reasoning. We summarize the consistency objective as:
paragraphs.zh: 用于Harness优化的对抗循环工程。 上述循环使用自动化反馈，取代了每轮的人工检查与修订指导。 由于这种反馈的可靠性取决于提示词、工具和评分标准的配置方式，因此在开发过程中，我们会在优化评判者和生成工作流程之间交替进行。 令θ J \theta_{J}表示评判者的证据呈现、评分标准、响应框架和聚合规则，θ H \theta_{H}表示Harness的提示词、契约、技能、工具和优化策略。 评判者优化首先固定生成工作流程，并反复评估已存储的工件库ℬ \mathcal{B}。 使用相同的工件可以将评判者行为的变化与生成过程中的变异性区分开来。 我们修订视角选择、证据呈现、缺陷检查清单以及评分聚合方式，以减少判断上的变异性以及与实测证据之间的矛盾。 评判者必须在给出评分前报告观察结果，且不会接收到生成器的推理过程。 我们将一致性目标总结如下：

paragraphs.en: Evaluation setup. We compare 3DCodeVerse against models with their native harnesses and Claude Design on 100 text-to-3D object prompts. We further compare against native harnesses on articulated-object generation, 50 scene prompts, and 50 graphics prompts. We evaluate generation quality using three metrics. Human Preference is the fraction of anonymized side-by-side comparisons won according to human evaluators, with ties split equally. VLM Preference is the fraction of the same comparisons won according to a VLM judge (Gemini 3.1 Pro), with ties split equally. Judge Score is Gemini 3.1 Pro’s overall rubric score, combining weighted criteria with defect penalties and score caps (0–100; failed generations receive a score of zero). Following 3DCodeBench ( Gao et al., 2026b ) , we additionally report SigLIP-2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) text–image cosine similarity averaged over four views. The evaluation judge is described in Appendix C.3 , and further evaluation details are in Appendix C.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 评估设置。 我们在 100 个文本到 3D 对象提示上，将 3DCodeVerse 与其原生工具链以及 Claude Design 进行比较。 我们还通过关节对象生成、50 个场景提示和 50 个图形提示，与原生工具链进行了进一步比较。 我们使用三项指标来评估生成质量。 人类偏好是指匿名并排比较中根据人类评估者赢得的比例，平局则均分。 VLM 偏好是指相同比较中根据 VLM 判官（Gemini 3.1 Pro）赢得的比例，平局则均分。 判官分数是 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的综合评分表得分，结合了加权标准、缺陷惩罚和分数上限（0–100；失败的生成得分为零）。 遵循 3DCodeBench（Gao et al., 2026b），我们还报告了 SigLIP-2（Tschannen et al., 2025）的文本-图像余弦相似度，该相似度在四个视角上取平均值。 评估判官的描述见附录 C.3，更多评估细节亦见附录 C.3。

paragraphs.en: Main Results. Figure 4 shows a consistent pattern across backbones and tasks: outputs from the native harness are rarely preferred, while the same backbone within 3DCodeVerse Harness wins most comparisons. On 3D objects, Human Preference for 3DCodeVerse Harness ranges from 69% to 89%, while Judge Score improves by 11–25 points. The largest gains occur for the weaker models, including Gemini 3.8 Flash (61 to 87) and GPT-6 Luna (64 to 86). Against Claude Design, which uses Claude Opus 5.5, 3DCodeVerse Harness with the same backbone is preferred in 90% of human comparisons and achieves a Judge Score of 88 versus 37. The same pattern extends to articulated objects, scenes, and graphics, where Human Preference reaches 78–88%. The agreement between human preference and rubric-based scores suggests that the gains are not specific to the VLM rubric used during refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 主要结果。 图4展示了不同基础模型和任务中一致的模式：原生工具的输出很少被偏好，而3DCodeVerse工具中使用相同基础模型的输出在大多数比较中胜出。 在3D对象上，人类对3DCodeVerse工具的偏好度在69%到89%之间，而评委得分则提升了11至25分。 提升幅度最大的出现在较弱的模型上，包括Gemini 3.8 Flash（从61提升至87）和GPT-6 Luna（从64提升至86）。 在与使用Claude Opus 5.5的Claude Design对比中，使用相同基础模型的3DCodeVerse工具在90%的人类比较中被偏好，并获得了88分的评委得分，而后者仅为37分。 同样的模式也适用于可活动部件对象、场景和图形，其中人类偏好度达到了78%至88%。 人类偏好与基于评分标准的分数之间的一致性表明，这些提升并非仅限于精炼过程中使用的VLM评分标准。

paragraphs.en: We fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) in LLaMA-Factory ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) on mixtures drawn from 3DCodeVerse -2M (Appendix C.1 ) and compare the resulting models with their respective pretrained checkpoints. Evaluation spans 805 fixed tasks across six suites: 212 text-to-Blender tasks from 3DCodeBench ( Gao et al., 2026b ) and five test splits drawn from 3DCodeVerse -2M: Blender (103 procedural objects), CadQuery (200 mechanical parts from DeepCAD and Articraft), OpenSCAD (50 Thingiverse models), GLSL (200 Shadertoy shaders), and Three.js (40 single-object scenes). Each task pairs a natural-language request with a reference program. Executing the reference program produces the evaluation target: a mesh for the four 3D suites, a rendered frame for GLSL, and a page screenshot for Three.js. All models receive the same request and per-dialect system prompt without examples, are decoded at T = 0.7 T{=}0.7 with one seed, and have every output executed in the dialect’s pinned runtime (Appendix C.3 ). We report the execution rate (Table 2 ) and fidelity to the target (Table 6 ): F@0.05 between the generated and reference meshes, and DINOv2-L similarity between clay renders of the two meshes from four fixed views; failed programs score zero on both.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 LLaMA-Factory（Zheng 等人，2024）中，使用 LoRA（Hu 等人，2021）对 Qwen3.5-9B 和 Qwen3.8-27B 模型进行微调，数据来自 3DCodeVerse -2M（附录 C.1），并将训练后的模型与其各自的预训练检查点进行比较。 评估涵盖六个套件中的 805 个固定任务：包括来自 3DCodeBench（Gao 等人，2026b）的 212 个文本到 Blender 的任务，以及从 3DCodeVerse -2M 中选取的五个测试分集：Blender（103 个过程化对象）、CadQuery（来自 DeepCAD 和 Articraft 的 200 个机械零件）、OpenSCAD（50 个 Thingiverse 模型）、GLSL（200 个 Shadertoy 着色器）和 Three.js（40 个单对象场景）。 每个任务都将一个自然语言请求与一个参考程序配对。 执行参考程序可生成评估目标：对于四个 3D 套件，目标是网格；对于 GLSL，是渲染后的帧；对于 Three.js，则是页面截图。 所有模型均接收相同的请求和每种方言的系统提示（不提供示例），在 T = 0.7 T{=}0.7 时以单一种子进行解码，且所有输出均在对应方言的固定运行时环境中执行（附录 C.3）。 我们报告了执行率（表 2）以及对目标结果的保真度（表 6）：即生成网格与参考网格之间的 F@0.05 指标，以及从四个固定视角对两个网格进行黏土渲染后得到的 DINOv2-L 相似度；程序执行失败的模型在这两项指标上均得零分。

paragraphs.en: Before fine-tuning, none of the programs generated by Qwen3.5-9B on 3DCodeBench execute successfully; most fail immediately by calling scene-clearing operators unavailable in Blender 5. After fine-tuning on 3DCodeVerse -2M, execution rises to 84.9% on 3DCodeBench , 90.3% on Blender, and 98.5% on CadQuery, with additional gains of 36.0 and 23.0 points on OpenSCAD and GLSL (Table 2 ). Qwen3.8-27B starts from a stronger baseline but shows the same trend: fine-tuning raises execution on 3DCodeBench from 51.9% to 92.9% (+41.0 points), on Blender to 93.2% (+18.4), and on CadQuery to 98.5% (+33.0).

paragraphs.en: For matched prompts and backbones, Figure 6 (a) shows that 3DCodeVerse Harness produces more complete structures and finer details, such as the phoenix’s legs and nest and the piano’s interior. Figure 6 (b) shows how successive refinement rounds correct specific defects, improving the phoenix’s facial feathers, attaching the stool legs to the seat, and reducing block artifacts in the neon shader. paragraphs.en: Robotics. 3D coding enables the construction of articulated assets and scenes with explicit geometry and physical constraints for simulated robot tasks. Programs encode rigid-link geometry, joint axes, and joint limits as editable parameters, supporting programmatic checks and controlled variation of object dimensions, articulation, and initial poses. These task instances can be executed in simulations to generate robot interactions and observations. To provide a preliminary evaluation, we import an articulated asset validated and exported with 3DCodeVerse tools into MuJoCo and compare rendered observations with frozen UWM ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) predictions across 12 cases spanning two assets, two contact states, and three control sequences, using complete scene state for rendering and image history with matched robot commands for UWM. Code renders and their UWM VAE reconstructions each pass a fixed door-and-handle geometry check in 12/12 outputs, versus 7/36 UWM predictions. These results show that 3D code can help generate articulated assets and scenes for robotics simulation with explicit geometry and physical constraints.

paragraphs.en: Video generation. 3D coding provides an editable interface for controlling the spatial and temporal conditions of video generation. Programs specify scene layout, object articulation and motion, and camera trajectories. We render generated 3D scenes using programs and harness them as reference videos, using the full sequences to condition Gemini Omni Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) and Seedance 2.5 ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) . The rendered videos supply spatial and temporal guidance, while the video models are used to refine visual appearance. We present paired reference and generated frames to examine how the specified layout, object motion, and camera trajectories are preserved. This application connects explicit scene programs with video synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成。3D 编码为控制视频生成的空间和时间条件提供了一个可编辑的界面。 程序会指定场景布局、物体关节与运动，以及摄像机轨迹。 我们使用程序渲染生成的 3D 场景，并将其用作参考视频，利用完整序列对 Gemini Omni Flash（Google DeepMind，2026）和 Seedance 2.5（ByteDance Seed，2026）进行条件约束。 渲染后的视频提供空间和时间上的指导，而视频模型则用于优化视觉外观。 我们展示成对的参考帧和生成帧，以检验指定的布局、物体运动和摄像机轨迹是否被保留。 这项应用将明确的场景程序与视频合成连接起来。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present 3DCodeVerse, an open ecosystem that provides a shared foundation for 3D coding through datasets, a reusable harness, and open model baselines. The dataset brings together programs across coding environments with descriptions, associated assets, and available quality records. The harness combines execution, spatial checks, and visual judgment to support iterative generation without human feedback during a run, while retaining the resulting programs and revisions for data curation. Experiments demonstrate the utility of the data for training open models and the benefits of the harness for existing coding agents. We will release the datasets, harness, models, and training recipes to support further research on 3D generation through code.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 3DCodeVerse——一个开放生态系统，通过数据集、可重用的框架以及开放模型基线，为 3D 编码提供共享基础。 该数据集整合了来自不同编码环境的程序，并附有描述、相关资产及可用的质量记录。 该框架结合了执行、空间检查和视觉判断，支持在运行过程中无需人类反馈即可进行迭代生成，同时保留生成的程序和修订版本以用于数据整理。 实验表明，这些数据对训练开放模型具有实用价值，而该框架则能为现有的编码智能体带来显著优势。 我们将发布数据集、框架、模型和训练方案，以支持后续关于通过代码实现 3D 生成的研究。

paragraphs.en: 3DCodeVerse Harness spans four generative tracks—static objects, articulated objects, 3D scenes, and procedural graphics—backed by seven isolated language runtimes: three for static objects (Blender Python, CadQuery, and Three.js), one each for articulated mechanisms (URDF with Blender-authored links) and scenes (Three.js), and two for graphics (GLSL and moderngl ). Each runtime specifies a strict file layout, static lint rules, a sandboxed build wrapper, canonical export formats, and a deterministic render driver, while sharing unified coordinate frames, metric units, camera rigs, and geometric tolerances.
paragraphs.zh: 3DCodeVerse Harness 涵盖四条生成轨道——静态对象、可动对象、3D 场景和过程化图形，并由七个独立的语言运行时提供支持：三个用于静态对象（Blender Python、CadQuery 和 Three.js），一个用于可动机制（URDF 搭配由 Blender 编写的链接），一个用于场景（Three.js），以及两个用于图形（GLSL 和 moderngl）。 每个运行时都规定了严格的文件布局、静态代码检查规则、沙盒化构建包装器、标准导出格式和确定性渲染驱动，同时共享统一的坐标框架、公制单位、相机配置和几何公差。

paragraphs.en: Each run decouples structural planning, code synthesis, and visual evaluation into three pluggable roles: a planner , a coding agent , and a vision–language judge (Figure 8 ). The planner and judge operate through a unified API interface, while the coding agent executes inside an isolated workspace equipped with the harness’s spatial tools via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), alongside a single-shot mode that requests a complete file envelope through direct API calls. Every round commits raw source code from which meshes and renders are deterministically regenerated; boilerplate infrastructure (camera rigging, coordinate conversion, URDF composition, scene assembly, and shader headers) resides in the harness, and verification proceeds strictly from fast programmatic gates to blind VLM judging.
paragraphs.zh: 每次运行都将结构规划、代码合成和视觉评估解耦为三个可插拔的角色：一个规划器、一个编码智能体和一个视觉-语言评判器（图8）。 规划器和评判器通过统一的API接口运行，而编码智能体则在隔离的工作空间内执行，该工作空间通过模型上下文协议（MCP）配备了工具集的空间工具，同时支持单次模式，通过直接API调用请求完整的文件包。 每一轮都会提交原始源代码，据此可确定性地重新生成网格和渲染结果；基础模板代码（相机支架、坐标转换、URDF组合、场景组装和着色器头文件）位于工具集中，验证过程则严格从快速的程序化检查开始，最终由无监督的VLM进行评判。

paragraphs.en: The planner translates an open-ended request into a schema-validated structural plan: named parts with metric bounding boxes, materials, symmetry, and attachment topology for static objects; a kinematic tree with typed joints, axes, pivots, limits, and acyclic affine mimic couplings ( q j = m j ​ q i + b j q_{j}=m_{j}q_{i}+b_{j} ) for articulated mechanisms; spatial zones, modular assets, effects, and authored cameras for scenes; and render passes, uniforms, and temporal dynamics for graphics. Each plan carries an acceptance checklist binding items to an evidence modality (measurement, visual inspection, probe, or joint sweep) and a priority ( must or should ), supplemented by canonical rules that normalize kinematic conventions and enforce requested dimensions ( ± 5 % \pm 5\% ), triangle budgets, grounding, and temporal motion.
paragraphs.zh: 规划器将开放式请求转换为经过模式验证的结构化计划：对于静态对象，包括带有度量边界框、材料、对称性和连接拓扑的命名部分；对于铰接机构，包括带有关节类型、轴、枢轴、限制和无环仿射模仿耦合（ q j = m j ​ q i + b j q_{j}=m_{j}q_{i}+b_{j} ）的运动学树；对于场景，包括空间区域、模块化资产、效果和自定义相机；以及用于图形渲染的渲染通道、统一变量和时间动态。 每个计划都附带一个验收检查清单，将各项内容绑定到一种证据模式（测量、视觉检查、探针或关节扫描）和一个优先级（必须或应该），并辅以标准化运动学惯例和强制执行指定尺寸（ ± 5 % \pm 5\% ）、三角形预算、接地和时间动态的规范规则。

paragraphs.en: Planning executes as a structured-output call with a token budget scaled to the target part count. Range or formatting violations are repaired in-context, whereas a degenerate kinematic hierarchy referencing undeclared links triggers a clean context reset from the original request (§ C.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 规划以结构化输出调用形式执行，其令牌预算会根据目标部件数量进行缩放。 范围或格式违规将在上下文中修复，而引用未声明连杆的退化运动学层级则会触发从原始请求开始的上下文彻底重置（§ C.5）。

sents.zh: 规划以结构化输出调用形式执行，其令牌预算会根据目标部件数量进行缩放。

sents.en: Range or formatting violations are repaired in-context, whereas a degenerate kinematic hierarchy referencing undeclared links triggers a clean context reset from the original request (§ C.5 ).

paragraphs.en: Each runtime maps plan targets to strict file-ownership scopes (per-part modules plus an assembly entry file for Blender and Three.js objects; a single program for CadQuery, URDF, and graphics; and per-zone and per-asset modules for scenes), and writes outside a session’s scope are reverted between Git commits. Objects with eight or more top-level parts in modular languages are synthesized via scoped sessions over attachment subtrees of at most three parts—each supplied with the planned bounding boxes of adjacent parts—followed by an assembly session (Figure 9 ). During refinement, tasks that share files are grouped into connected components and dispatched as file-disjoint sessions, bounding per-session context and preventing cross-part regressions (§ C.5 ), while best-of- N N candidates and scene assets run concurrently in isolated workspaces.
paragraphs.zh: 每个运行时都将计划目标映射到严格的文件所有权范围（Blender 和 Three.js 对象按部件划分模块，外加一个装配入口文件；CadQuery、URDF 和图形使用单个程序；场景则按区域和资产划分模块），并且会话范围之外的写入操作会在 Git 提交之间被回滚。 在模块化语言中，包含八个或更多顶层部件的对象通过限定范围的会话进行合成，这些会话作用于最多三个部件的附着子树——每个子树都附带相邻部件的计划边界框——随后再进行一次装配会话（图 9）。 在优化过程中，共享文件的任务会被分组为连通分量，并以文件互不重叠的会话形式分发，从而限制每个会话的上下文并防止跨部件的回退（§ C.5）；同时，“最佳 N 选 1”候选者和场景资产会在隔离的工作空间中并发运行。

paragraphs.en: Every agent workspace is provisioned with a standardized instruction specification containing the runtime invariants, track-specific tool schemas, and language contracts. paragraphs.en: Every tool response separates the semantic verification verdict ( pass / fail ) from the tool execution status . A detected mesh collision or build failure is returned as a valid observation leading with a structured fail verdict; only an internal tool crash sets the MCP protocol error flag, preventing commercial coding agents from entering degenerate transport-retry loops (§ C.5 ). Tool responses bound text length and image resolution, attaching diagnostic renders specifically when a check identifies actionable geometric defects.
paragraphs.zh: 每个工具响应都将语义验证结果（通过/失败）与工具执行状态分开。 检测到的网格碰撞或构建失败会被返回为有效的观察结果，并以结构化的失败结果开头；只有内部工具崩溃才会设置 MCP 协议错误标志，从而防止商业编码智能体进入退化的传输重试循环（§ C.5）。 工具响应受限于文本长度和图像分辨率，并且仅在检查发现可操作的几何缺陷时附加诊断渲染图。

paragraphs.en: Following each successful build, the track pipeline executes its deterministic gates. Gate errors compile into high-priority revision tasks with numerical fix hints and impose hard upper bounds on the round’s rubric score, while warnings are surfaced to the judge. Conversely, passing a deterministic gate vetoes contradictory visual defect claims from the VLM judge (§ A.4 ). In the connectivity gate, the ground-contacting component with the largest face count defines the primary support structure, and any disconnected component is reported alongside its nearest supported neighbour and the exact 3D translation vector that closes the gap. A contact ledger tracks all planned part attachments with their measured clearances while enforcing structural support at the global assembly level. The contract gate verifies built part counts, orientations, and bounding-box extents against the structural plan within per-axis tolerances.
paragraphs.zh: 每次成功构建后，流程管道都会执行其确定性门控。 门控错误会被编译为高优先级的修订任务，并附带数值化修复提示；同时，这些错误会对本轮评分标准施加严格的上限限制，而警告则会反馈给评审员。 相反，通过确定性门控将否决来自视觉语言模型评审员的矛盾性外观缺陷主张（§ A.4）。 在连通性门控中，具有最大面数的地面接触部件被定义为主要支撑结构；任何不连通的部件都会与其最近的受支撑邻接部件以及用于填补间隙的精确三维平移向量一同被报告。 接触记录表会追踪所有计划中的部件附着及其测量间隙，同时确保在全球装配层级上满足结构支撑要求。 合同门控会在各轴容差范围内，验证已构建部件的数量、朝向和边界框尺寸是否与结构计划一致。

paragraphs.en: A single payload builder serves in-loop refinement, post-run evaluation, and judge calibration (Figure 11 ). The judge receives the request, plan digest, acceptance checklist, measurements, gate findings, and track telemetry, together with up to five labelled multi-view montages, detail crops, and—when connectivity errors occur—cross-sectional slices, with montage order randomized per sample to remove positional bias. On object tracks, a passing connectivity gate prohibits unverified visual claims of floating or interpenetrating parts. The judge answers in a strict JSON schema at temperature 0.2 0.2 , stating its evidence, strengths, issues, defect votes, and checklist verifications before assigning criterion scores and up to six prioritized improvement instructions; deterministic criteria such as silhouette IoU are injected by code.
paragraphs.zh: 单个载荷构建器负责循环内优化、运行后评估和裁判校准（图 11）。 裁判接收请求、计划摘要、接受检查清单、测量数据、关卡结果和轨道遥测数据，以及最多五个带标签的多视角合成图像、细节裁剪，以及在出现连接错误时提供的横截面切片；为消除位置偏差，每份样本的合成图像顺序均随机化。 在物体轨道上，通过连接性关卡会禁止未经验证的关于漂浮或相互穿透部件的视觉判断。 裁判以温度 0.2 0.2 的模式按照严格的 JSON schema 作答，说明其证据、优势、问题、缺陷投票和检查清单验证结果，然后分配标准分数并提供最多六条优先级排序的改进建议；诸如轮廓 IoU 等确定性标准由代码注入。

paragraphs.en: For pairwise preference evaluation, the judge inspects anonymized candidates under both display orders and declares a winner only when both orders concur; reference-conditioned and likeness modes additionally incorporate measured silhouette IoU and real-world photographs. Across repeated evaluations of fixed chair and cabinet artifacts under shuffled montage orders, Gemini 3.1 Pro achieves a mean score standard deviation of 0.030 0.030 ( 0.035 0.035 under fixed order, compared with 0.083 0.083 for Gemini 3.8 Flash), confirming that our primary evaluator provides a high-precision, view-order-robust scoring signal (§ C.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在成对偏好评估中，评审员会检查两种显示顺序下的匿名候选项，并且只有当两种顺序的结果一致时才会宣布获胜者；参考条件约束和相似性模式还会额外纳入测量得到的轮廓 IoU 和真实世界照片。 在对固定椅子和柜体文物进行多次评估时，评估顺序采用随机组合方式，Gemini 3.1 Pro 的平均分数标准差为 0.030（在固定顺序下为 0.035），而 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的标准差则为 0.083，这证实了我们的主要评估器能够提供高精度且对显示顺序具有鲁棒性的评分信号（§ C.3）。

paragraphs.en: Pre-round stages are cached, whereas every round executes fresh through a fixed verification chain: code synthesis, build with bounded repair, geometric measurement, deterministic gates, multi-view rendering, VLM judgment, and Git archival. A failed build triggers up to three targeted repair sessions supplied with the error location, traceback, lint diagnostics, and relevant cookbook snippets, and every completed round is committed with a journal entry of its telemetry, verdicts, renders, and token usage. Refinement tasks are compiled from the preceding round in strict priority order—deterministic gate errors with numerical fix hints, then unverified mandatory checklist items, then the judge’s perceptual instructions—and deduplicated by part and defect category. At most six tasks are dispatched per round, and truncation applies only to perceptual suggestions, so gate errors and mandatory items are never dropped; reference-conditioned runs append a silhouette task whenever outline IoU falls below 0.60 0.60 .
paragraphs.zh: 预回合阶段会被缓存，而每个回合都会通过固定的验证链重新执行：代码合成、带有限制性修复的构建、几何测量、确定性门控、多视图渲染、VLM判断以及Git归档。 构建失败会触发最多三次有针对性的修复会话，并提供错误位置、堆栈跟踪、lint诊断和相关的食谱片段；每个完成的回合都会通过提交日志记录其遥测数据、判定结果、渲染输出和令牌使用情况。 优化任务按照严格的优先级顺序从前一个回合编译而来——首先是带有数值修复提示的确定性门控错误，其次是未验证的强制性检查清单项，最后是评审员的感知指令——并按部分和缺陷类别进行去重。 每个回合最多派发六个任务，且截断仅适用于感知性建议，因此门控错误和强制性项目绝不会被舍弃；参考条件运行的流程会在轮廓IoU低于0.60 0.60时附加一个轮廓任务。

sents.en: A failed build triggers up to three targeted repair sessions supplied with the error location, traceback, lint diagnostics, and relevant cookbook snippets, and every completed round is committed with a journal entry of its telemetry, verdicts, renders, and token usage.
sents.zh: 构建失败会触发最多三次有针对性的修复会话，并提供错误位置、堆栈跟踪、lint诊断和相关的食谱片段；每个完成的回合都会通过提交日志记录其遥测数据、判定结果、渲染输出和令牌使用情况。

sents.en: Refinement tasks are compiled from the preceding round in strict priority order—deterministic gate errors with numerical fix hints, then unverified mandatory checklist items, then the judge’s perceptual instructions—and deduplicated by part and defect category.
sents.zh: 优化任务按照严格的优先级顺序从前一个回合编译而来——首先是带有数值修复提示的确定性门控错误，其次是未验证的强制性检查清单项，最后是评审员的感知指令——并按部分和缺陷类别进行去重。

sents.en: At most six tasks are dispatched per round, and truncation applies only to perceptual suggestions, so gate errors and mandatory items are never dropped; reference-conditioned runs append a silhouette task whenever outline IoU falls below 0.60 0.60 .
sents.zh: 每个回合最多派发六个任务，且截断仅适用于感知性建议，因此门控错误和强制性项目绝不会被舍弃；参考条件运行的流程会在轮廓IoU低于0.60 0.60时附加一个轮廓任务。

paragraphs.en: The standard profile allocates up to T = 4 T=4 refinement rounds and a 60 60 -minute wall-clock ceiling; refinement stops early once all verification tasks are resolved, a round makes no code change, or the budget is reached, while monetary cost is logged for accounting only. With multi-candidate initialization, the baseline round synthesizes N N independent candidates, ranks them lexicographically by build success, quick rubric score, and gate error count on a four-view rig, and seeds Round 0 0 with the winner.
paragraphs.zh: 标准配置文件最多分配 T = 4 T=4 轮细化，并设置 60 分钟的实际运行时间上限；一旦所有验证任务全部解决、某轮未产生任何代码变更或达到预算上限，细化过程将提前终止，而货币成本仅用于记录以供核算。 在多候选初始化模式下，基线轮会合成 N 个独立的候选方案，按照构建成功情况、快速评分表得分以及四视图测试台上的门错误数量进行字典序排序，并将获胜者作为第 0 轮的初始输入。

paragraphs.en: Judged rounds are ranked by composite rubric score, breaking ties by fewer gate errors and earlier round index. When the top two rounds fall within 0.03 0.03 , an optional pairwise VLM tie-breaker promotes the runner-up only if it wins both presentation orders with confidence ≥ 0.60 \geq 0.60 . The selected round is packaged directly from its Git commit and verified artifacts without re-executing the build.
paragraphs.zh: 评审轮次按综合评分表得分进行排名，若得分相同，则依据门错误更少和轮次索引更早的原则决定名次。 当排名前两的轮次得分差在 0.03 以内时，可选用成对 VLM 决胜机制：仅当亚军在所有两种展示顺序中均以置信度 ≥ 0.60 获胜时，才会将其提升为第一名。 选定的轮次将直接从其 Git 提交和已验证的产物中打包，无需重新执行构建过程。

paragraphs.en: Figure 12 traces a complete run for the prompt “a three-legged wooden stool” on the Three.js runtime under the economy profile. The planner decomposes the stool into seven parts (a circular seat slab, three splayed legs, and three through-tenon wedges) with eleven checklist items, including four signature structural features. In the baseline round ( t = 0 t=0 ), the initial script builds, but deterministic gates identify multiple structural violations: the connectivity gate detects three wedge–seat interpenetrations ( ≈ 22 \approx 22 mm) and six disconnected parts floating up to 212 212 mm from the support component; two legs exceed their planned bounding-box tolerances; and the mesh contains only 1,572 1{,}572 triangles against a detail floor of 2,450 2{,}450 , yielding a composite score of 0.410 0.410 ( 0.59 0.59 weighted criterion mean minus 0.18 0.18 in defect penalties). The harness compiles nine prioritized revision tasks—eight from deterministic gate errors with exact authoring-frame translation vectors and one from the footprint specification—and dispatches them across eight file-disjoint sessions. By Round 1, every structural defect is resolved: all seven parts form a single ground-supported assembly with nine verified contacts, lifting the score by + 0.434 +0.434 to 0.844 0.844 . Round 2 addresses the remaining geometric and metric refinements—carving recessed mortise slots, chamfering the slab rims, and increasing leg splay—expanding mesh detail to 11,052 11{,}052 triangles and reaching a score of 0.933 0.933 (bounded by the graded checklist cap of 0.6 + 0.4 × 5 / 6 0.6+0.4\times 5/6 for a 0.34 0.34 m vs. 0.38 0.38 m base diameter). The complete trajectory finishes in 21 21 model calls, 4.0 4.0 active minutes, and $0.74, and the output selector packages Round 2.
paragraphs.zh: 图 12 记录了在 Three.js 运行时以经济模式执行“一个三条腿的木制凳子”提示词时的完整运行过程。 规划器将凳子分解为七个部分（一个圆形座板、三条外张的腿和三个贯穿榫卯楔块），并包含十一个检查清单项目，其中四个是关键结构特征。 在基准轮次（ t = 0 t=0 ）中，初始脚本完成了构建，但确定性检查门识别出多处结构违规：连通性检查门检测到三个楔块与座板的相互穿透（≈ 22 \approx 22 mm），以及六个与支撑组件最多相距 212 212 mm 的孤立部件；两条腿超出了其规划边界框的容差；网格仅包含 1,572 1{,}572 个三角形，远低于 2,450 2{,}450 的细节基准线，最终综合得分为 0.410 0.410（即加权标准均分 0.59 0.59 减去缺陷惩罚的 0.18 0.18）。 约束系统编译了九个优先级的修订任务——其中八个来自确定性检查门的错误，并附带精确的创作框架平移向量，还有一个来自底面规格要求——然后将这些任务分配到八个文件互不重叠的会话中执行。 到第一轮结束时，所有结构缺陷均已解决：全部七个部分形成了一个由地面支撑的整体组件，并验证了九个接触点，使得分提升了 +0.434 +0.434，达到 0.844 0.844。 第二轮处理了剩余的几何和尺寸优化任务——包括雕刻嵌入式榫槽、对座板边缘进行倒角处理以及增加腿部的外张角度——使网格细节扩展至 11,052 11{,}052 个三角形，得分达到 0.933 0.933（受分级检查清单上限 0.6 + 0.4 × 5 / 6 0.6+0.4\times 5/6 的限制，该上限基于 0.34 0.34 m 与 0.38 0.38 m 的底座直径差异）。 完整流程共消耗 21 21 次模型调用、4.0 4.0 分钟活跃时间和 $0.74，最终输出选择器打包了第二轮的结果。

paragraphs.en: During the build stage, the harness compares each link’s forward-kinematic bounding box at q = 0 q=0 against its authored mesh; any alignment discrepancy exceeding 1 1 mm or rest-pose interpenetration exceeding 5 5 mm fails the build with an exact origin correction, guaranteeing rest-pose geometric–kinematic consistency prior to dynamic sweep evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 在构建阶段，测试框架会将每个连杆在 q = 0 时的正向运动学边界框与其设计的网格进行比较；任何超过 1 毫米的对齐差异或超过 5 毫米的静息姿态穿插，都会导致构建失败，并触发精确的原点校正，从而在动态扫描评估之前确保静息姿态的几何与运动学一致性。

paragraphs.en: The dynamic joint sweep then articulates the mechanism across its rest pose, the lower, midpoint, and upper limits of each independent joint, and eight seeded multi-joint configurations, resolving coupled followers analytically through the mimic graph. Interpenetrations exceeding 2 2 mm in any articulated pose ( 5 5 mm at rest) are flagged per link pair, while mobile child links separated by more than 30 30 mm from their parent at rest ( 2 2 mm for fixed joints) are flagged as unattached. A motion-direction check verifies that each joint’s displacement vector aligns with the planned motion semantics and proposes axis corrections when inverted. The VLM judge inspects the multi-pose articulation sheet alongside these geometric findings, while deterministic caps bound the score at 0.60 0.60 for dynamic collisions or unattached links, 0.30 0.30 for URDF schema errors, and 0.50 0.50 for missing pose sheets (see Appendix C.5 for kinematic coupling ablations).
paragraphs.zh: 动态联合扫掠随后在静止姿态下对机构进行关节活动，涵盖每个独立关节的下限、中点和上限，以及八种初始多关节构型，并通过模仿图对耦合的从动关节进行解析求解。 在任何关节活动姿态中，若穿插距离超过 2.2 毫米（静止时为 5.5 毫米），则按连杆对标记；若可移动子连杆在静止时与父连杆的距离超过 30 毫米（固定关节为 2.2 毫米），则标记为未连接。 运动方向检查会验证每个关节的位移向量是否与规划的运动语义一致，并在方向相反时提出轴心修正建议。 VLM 评判器会结合这些几何分析结果，检查多姿态关节活动表；同时，确定性上限将动态碰撞或未连接连杆的得分限制在 0.60，URDF 模式错误的得分限制在 0.30，缺失姿态表的得分限制在 0.50（运动学耦合消融分析参见附录 C.5）。

paragraphs.en: Scene synthesis executes a staged hierarchical pipeline prior to the main refinement loop (Figure 14 a). Individual scene assets (up to eight, or four under tight budget thresholds) follow a progressive compute-escalation policy: each asset begins with a fast single-shot draft and deterministic check, escalating to a full interactive agent session only if automated repair does not resolve all findings; Blender-built hero assets additionally undergo VLM evaluation with a monotonic quality gate that retains a revision pass only if it strictly improves the asset score. Environmental terrains and spatial zone layouts are built concurrently, followed by a unified cross-zone composition session and deterministic scene-graph assembly. To guarantee timely completion on complex prompts, pre-round staging is bounded at 55 % 55\% of the wall-clock budget, dynamically switching remaining pre-round stages to fast single-shot synthesis once reached. Scene gates enforce asset grounding and collision bounds, runtime console cleanliness, per-camera exposure and framing coverage, inter-frame animation motion, asset utilization, and a 15,000 15{,}000 draw-call budget across up to ten authored and overview camera views.
paragraphs.zh: 场景合成在主优化循环之前执行一个分阶段的分层流程（图 14a）。 单个场景资产（最多八个，或在严格的预算阈值下为四个）遵循逐步提升计算资源的策略：每个资产首先通过快速单次生成草图和确定性检查；仅当自动修复未能解决所有问题时，才会升级到完整的交互式智能体会话。此外，Blender 构建的核心资产还会经过 VLM 评估，采用单调质量门控机制——只有当修订步骤严格提升资产得分时，才会保留该修订版本。 环境地形和空间区域布局同步构建，随后进行统一的跨区域构图会话和确定性场景图组装。 为确保复杂提示能按时完成，预阶段部署的占用时间上限为实际可用预算的 55%（55\%）；一旦达到该上限，剩余预阶段将动态切换为快速单次合成。 场景门控机制强制要求资产与场景的对应关系和碰撞边界符合规范、运行时控制台保持整洁、每路摄像机的曝光与构图覆盖完整、帧间动画运动连贯、资产使用合理，并且在最多十个自定义及概览摄像机视角中，总绘制调用数不超过 15,000（15{,}000）。

sents.zh: 场景合成在主优化循环之前执行一个分阶段的分层流程（图 14a）。

sents.en: Individual scene assets (up to eight, or four under tight budget thresholds) follow a progressive compute-escalation policy: each asset begins with a fast single-shot draft and deterministic check, escalating to a full interactive agent session only if automated repair does not resolve all findings; Blender-built hero assets additionally undergo VLM evaluation with a monotonic quality gate that retains a revision pass only if it strictly improves the asset score.
sents.zh: 单个场景资产（最多八个，或在严格的预算阈值下为四个）遵循逐步提升计算资源的策略：每个资产首先通过快速单次生成草图和确定性检查；仅当自动修复未能解决所有问题时，才会升级到完整的交互式智能体会话。此外，Blender 构建的核心资产还会经过 VLM 评估，采用单调质量门控机制——只有当修订步骤严格提升资产得分时，才会保留该修订版本。

sents.en: Environmental terrains and spatial zone layouts are built concurrently, followed by a unified cross-zone composition session and deterministic scene-graph assembly.
sents.zh: 环境地形和空间区域布局同步构建，随后进行统一的跨区域构图会话和确定性场景图组装。

sents.en: To guarantee timely completion on complex prompts, pre-round staging is bounded at 55 % 55\% of the wall-clock budget, dynamically switching remaining pre-round stages to fast single-shot synthesis once reached.
sents.zh: 为确保复杂提示能按时完成，预阶段部署的占用时间上限为实际可用预算的 55%（55\%）；一旦达到该上限，剩余预阶段将动态切换为快速单次合成。

sents.en: Scene gates enforce asset grounding and collision bounds, runtime console cleanliness, per-camera exposure and framing coverage, inter-frame animation motion, asset utilization, and a 15,000 15{,}000 draw-call budget across up to ten authored and overview camera views.
sents.zh: 场景门控机制强制要求资产与场景的对应关系和碰撞边界符合规范、运行时控制台保持整洁、每路摄像机的曝光与构图覆盖完整、帧间动画运动连贯、资产使用合理，并且在最多十个自定义及概览摄像机视角中，总绘制调用数不超过 15,000（15{,}000）。

paragraphs.en: On the graphics track, the agent authors either a Shadertoy-style GLSL fragment shader (with optional multipass feedback buffers) or a moderngl Python program defining setup and per-frame render routines, while the harness injects standardized headers, uniforms, outputs, and brief-matched reference recipes (Figure 14 b). Sequences are rendered at t ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2.5 , 4 , 6 } t\in\{0,1,2.5,4,6\} s (clipped to the loop duration) at 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 resolution. The deterministic frame gate measures luminance distribution, colourfulness, edge density, inter-frame motion, and pixel validity: NaN, all-black, or overexposed frames trigger hard errors, while static or flickering sequences trigger score-capping warnings. The judge evaluates multi-frame montages paired with frame telemetry, and each refinement round dispatches a unified whole-program optimization task.
paragraphs.zh: 在图形赛道中，智能体需要编写 Shadertoy 风格的 GLSL 片段着色器（可选配多通道反馈缓冲区），或定义设置和每帧渲染流程的 moderngl Python 程序，同时测试框架会注入标准化的头文件、统一变量、输出以及简要匹配的参考方案（图 14b）。 序列在 t ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2.5 , 4 , 6 } t\in\{0,1,2.5,4,6\} s（裁剪至循环时长）的时间点上，以 1280 × 720 分辨率进行渲染。 确定性帧门会测量亮度分布、色彩丰富度、边缘密度、帧间运动以及像素有效性：NaN、全黑或过曝的帧会触发硬性错误，而静态或闪烁的序列则会触发分数上限警告。 评判器会评估与帧遥测数据配对的跨帧蒙太奇，并且每次优化迭代都会派出一个统一的完整程序优化任务。

paragraphs.en: The authoring skill library (§ 3 and § 4 ) comprises seventeen modular bundles in the open agent-skill format, each pairing a concise instruction sheet with a code reference file bounded at 350 350 lines and ≈ 2,500 {\approx}2{,}500 tokens (Table 3 ). A 28 28 -rule routing table dynamically selects up to five highest-priority bundles per session through two complementary mechanisms: standing routes , which match the active track, runtime language, session role, and planned structural features, and diagnostic routes , which trigger on specific gate findings from the preceding round (for example, attaching threejs-shader-traps whenever the shader preflight gate fires).
paragraphs.zh: 创作技能库（§ 3 和 § 4）包含十七个基于开放智能体-技能格式构建的模块化包，每个模块都配有一张简洁的说明表和一份代码参考文件，后者行数上限为 350 行，令牌数约为 2,500 {\approx}2{,}500（表 3）。 一个包含 28 条规则的转发表通过两种互补机制动态选择每轮最多五个优先级最高的模块：常驻路线，用于匹配当前轨道、运行时语言、会话角色和计划的结构特征；以及诊断路线，在上一轮出现特定关卡结果时触发（例如，当着色器预检关卡触发时，附加 threejs-shader-traps）。

paragraphs.en: 3DCodeVerse -2M is organized into three tiers that separate curated programs, benchmark training splits, and multi-representation exports. The catalogue indexes 269,597 269{,}597 unique executable programs across nine collections (Table 4 ), spanning parametric CAD, procedural Blender Python, OpenSCAD, articulated URDF mechanisms, Three.js scenes, and GLSL shaders. The benchmark training pairs ( 768,596 768{,}596 pairs, 891 891 M tokens) are deduplicated prompt–code splits, including web-animation programs, built for the fine-tuning experiments of § 5.2 and Appendix C.1 ; they strictly exclude all 3DCodeBench procedural factories, seeded instances, and per-dialect evaluation suites. The unified text export ( 2,028,286 2{,}028{,}286 rows across 342 342 shards) expands each curated program across its three caption views (visual description, instruction, and factory recipe) and decomposes multi-pass shaders into pass-level targets: 891,788 891{,}788 native-format rows, 848,819 848{,}819 standardized text-export rows, and 287,679 287{,}679 pass-flattened shader rows.
paragraphs.zh: 3DCodeVerse -2M 分为三个层级，分别用于管理精选程序、基准训练分割和多表示导出。 该目录索引了九个集合中的 269,597 个唯一可执行程序（表 4），涵盖参数化 CAD、过程化 Blender Python、OpenSCAD、铰接式 URDF 机制、Three.js 场景和 GLSL 着色器。 基准训练配对（768,596 对，891 M 个词元）是去重后的提示–代码分割，包括网页动画程序，用于 § 5.2 和附录 C.1 中的微调实验；它们严格排除了所有 3DCodeBench 过程化工厂、种子实例和每种方言的评估套件。 统一文本导出（342 个分片中共计 2,028,286 行）将每个精选程序扩展至其三种标题视图（视觉描述、指令和工厂配方），并将多通道着色器分解为通道级目标：891,788 行原生格式数据、848,819 行标准化文本导出数据以及 287,679 行经通道展平的着色器数据。

paragraphs.en: DeepCAD provides 178,238 178{,}238 raw sketch–extrusion command sequences rather than executable programs ( Wu et al., 2021 ) . Our deterministic compiler translates each command sequence into a self-contained CadQuery script: 174,981 174{,}981 sequences compile ( 98.2 % 98.2\% ), 174,177 174{,}177 produce valid watertight solids ( 97.7 % 97.7\% ), and vector-level hashing removes 25.8 % 25.8\% exact geometric duplicates to yield 128,201 128{,}201 unique executable programs ( 71.9 % 71.9\% of raw sequences). Geometric fidelity against the original solids, measured via voxel IoU at 48 3 48^{3} resolution, averages 0.985 0.985 , with 96.9 % 96.9\% of programs exceeding 0.90 0.90 (the remaining 1,114 1{,}114 programs are annotated with explicit fidelity metadata so downstream pipelines can apply custom thresholds). Natural-language annotations from Text2CAD ( Khan et al., 2024 ) are paired with 125,162 125{,}162 programs under their original license terms, accompanied by four canonical views per solid. Crucially, because the upstream DeepCAD split contains 3,230 3{,}230 duplicate geometry groups straddling its train and test partitions, our vector-and-mesh deduplication eliminates cross-split leakage across the CAD lineage.
paragraphs.zh: DeepCAD 提供了 178,238 个原始草图-拉伸命令序列，而非可执行程序（Wu 等人，2021）。 我们的确定性编译器将每个命令序列转换为一个自包含的 CadQuery 脚本：其中 174,981 个序列成功编译（98.2%），174,177 个生成了有效的无孔实体（97.7%），而向量级哈希则移除了 25.8% 的完全相同的几何重复项，最终得到 128,201 个独特的可执行程序（占原始序列的 71.9%）。 通过 48³ 分辨率的体素 IoU 衡量的原始实体几何保真度平均为 0.985，其中 96.9% 的程序超过了 0.90（其余 1,114 个程序标注了明确的保真度元数据，以便下游流程可以应用自定义阈值）。 Text2CAD（Khan 等人，2024）提供的自然语言标注与 125,162 个程序一同提供，这些程序均保留其原始许可条款，并附带每个实体的四个标准视图。 关键在于，由于上游 DeepCAD 的数据划分包含 3,230 个跨越训练集和测试集的重复几何组，我们的向量和网格去重方法消除了整个 CAD 谱系中的跨划分泄露问题。

paragraphs.en: The procedural graphics collection comprises 119,961 119{,}961 Shadertoy shaders— 98,164 98{,}164 single-pass and 21,585 21{,}585 multi-pass programs—indexed with one canonical record per shader ( Quilez & Jeremias, 2013 ) . Each record stores the primary image pass as the indexed entry file alongside the complete multi-pass buffer source tree, multi-frame render grids, video clips, and bound input textures. For text-to-code training, multi-pass shaders are additionally expanded by prepending shared common headers to each buffer pass ( 287,679 287{,}679 pass-level rows); automated syntax and uniform repair across 588 588 shaders lifts the headless compilation rate of the flattened set from 84.6 % 84.6\% to 99.0% ( 92,534 92{,}534 of 93,434 93{,}434 ), with only compiled shaders admitted to training mixtures.
paragraphs.zh: 该过程化图形集包含 119,961 个 Shadertoy 着色器——其中 98,164 个为单通道程序，21,585 个为多通道程序——每个着色器均通过一个标准记录进行索引（Quilez & Jeremias, 2013）。 每个记录都将主图像通道作为索引条目文件存储，同时包含完整的多通道缓冲区源树、多帧渲染网格、视频剪辑和绑定输入纹理。 在文本到代码的训练中，通过在每个缓冲区通道前添加共享公共头文件，进一步扩展了多通道着色器（287,679 个通道级行）；对 588 个着色器的自动语法和统一变量修复，使扁平化集合的无头编译率从 84.6% 提升至 99.0%（93,434 个中成功编译了 92,534 个），且仅允许已编译的着色器进入训练混合集。

paragraphs.en: The 9,996 9{,}996 upstream Articraft records ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) partition into 6,882 6{,}882 mesh-based CAD assemblies and 3,114 3{,}114 primitive-based articulated mechanisms. For the mesh-based assemblies, we perform a clean-room reimplementation of the Articraft geometry helpers coupled with a tree-shaking AST inliner to produce standalone CadQuery programs (median ≈ 900 {\approx}900 lines), verifying every output against the upstream geometry via Chamfer distance ( < 0.02 <0.02 ) and bounding-box aspect ratio ( ∈ [ 0.9 , 1.1 ] \in[0.9,1.1] ); 6,878 6{,}878 of 6,882 6{,}882 ( 99.9 % 99.9\% ) pass verification and are rendered from eight canonical views. The primitive-based mechanisms are packaged as executable URDF specifications across geometry-only and textured variants ( 6,146 6{,}146 records in total, including 3,032 3{,}032 textured mechanisms) with multi-pose kinematic renders.
paragraphs.zh: 上游的 9,996 9{,}996 个 Articraft 记录（Zhou 等人，2026）被划分为 6,882 6{,}882 个基于网格的 CAD 装配体和 3,114 3{,}114 个基于原语的铰接机构。 对于基于网格的装配体，我们对 Articraft 几何辅助函数进行了“洁净室”式重新实现，并结合了树状简化 AST 内联器，以生成独立的 CadQuery 程序（中位数约为 900 {\approx}900 行），并通过倒角距离（< 0.02 <0.02）和边界框纵横比（∈ [ 0.9 , 1.1 ] \in[0.9,1.1]）将每个输出与上游几何进行验证；6,882 个装配体中有 6,878 个（99.9 % 99.9\%）通过了验证，并已从八个标准视角进行了渲染。 基于原语的机构被打包为可执行的 URDF 规范，涵盖仅几何体和带纹理的变体（共 6,146 6{,}146 个记录，包括 3,032 3{,}032 个带纹理的机构），并附带多姿态运动学渲染。

sents.zh: 上游的 9,996 9{,}996 个 Articraft 记录（Zhou 等人，2026）被划分为 6,882 6{,}882 个基于网格的 CAD 装配体和 3,114 3{,}114 个基于原语的铰接机构。

sents.en: For the mesh-based assemblies, we perform a clean-room reimplementation of the Articraft geometry helpers coupled with a tree-shaking AST inliner to produce standalone CadQuery programs (median ≈ 900 {\approx}900 lines), verifying every output against the upstream geometry via Chamfer distance ( < 0.02 <0.02 ) and bounding-box aspect ratio ( ∈ [ 0.9 , 1.1 ] \in[0.9,1.1] ); 6,878 6{,}878 of 6,882 6{,}882 ( 99.9 % 99.9\% ) pass verification and are rendered from eight canonical views.
sents.zh: 对于基于网格的装配体，我们对 Articraft 几何辅助函数进行了“洁净室”式重新实现，并结合了树状简化 AST 内联器，以生成独立的 CadQuery 程序（中位数约为 900 {\approx}900 行），并通过倒角距离（< 0.02 <0.02）和边界框纵横比（∈ [ 0.9 , 1.1 ] \in[0.9,1.1]）将每个输出与上游几何进行验证；6,882 个装配体中有 6,878 个（99.9 % 99.9\%）通过了验证，并已从八个标准视角进行了渲染。

sents.en: The primitive-based mechanisms are packaged as executable URDF specifications across geometry-only and textured variants ( 6,146 6{,}146 records in total, including 3,032 3{,}032 textured mechanisms) with multi-pose kinematic renders.
sents.zh: 基于原语的机构被打包为可执行的 URDF 规范，涵盖仅几何体和带纹理的变体（共 6,146 6{,}146 个记录，包括 3,032 3{,}032 个带纹理的机构），并附带多姿态运动学渲染。

paragraphs.en: The remaining sources (Table 4 ) are all execution-verified: (1) Bioinspired3D ( Luu & Buehler, 2026a ) , 6,343 6{,}343 Blender Python programs ( 4,557 4{,}557 geometry programs and 1,786 1{,}786 material-textured variants) that all execute, export, and render from five views; (2) Thingiverse OpenSCAD , 1,193 1{,}193 parametric projects curated from 7,378 7{,}378 community designs, with their original source files, five renders, and item-level license metadata; (3) 3DCodeBench factories , 486 486 procedural Blender generators ( 243 243 factories derived from Infinigen ( Raistrick et al., 2023 ) , each in geometry and textured variants, averaging ≈ 880 {\approx}880 lines) and 3,904 3{,}904 curated seeded instances ( 1,953 1{,}953 geometry and 1,951 1{,}951 textured), all held out from benchmark training because the 212 212 3DCodeBench tasks come from the same generator family (Appendix C.1 ); (4) agent-authored programs , 949 949 Blender Python programs and 1,134 1{,}134 Three.js scenes synthesized by coding agents under execution and render verification (from 1,040 1{,}040 and 1,389 1{,}389 attempts), plus 25 25 multi-file Three.js repositories and 1,051 1{,}051 web-animation programs across 21 21 categories; and (5) harness-generated bootstrap programs , 15,704 15{,}704 execution-verified programs carrying quality tiers, checklist verdicts, and gate telemetry, which substantially improve target-dialect executability in our fine-tuning mixtures (§ C.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 其余的数据源（表4）均经过执行验证：(1) Bioinspired3D（Luu & Buehler, 2026a），包含6,343个Blender Python程序（其中4,557个为几何程序，1,786个为带材质纹理的变体），这些程序均能执行、导出并从五个视角进行渲染；(2) Thingiverse OpenSCAD，包含从7,378个社区设计中精选出的1,193个参数化项目，附带其原始源文件、五个渲染结果以及项目级别的许可元数据；(3) 3DCodeBench工厂，包含486个过程化的Blender生成器（其中243个工厂源自Infinigen（Raistrick et al., 2023），每个工厂均有几何体和带纹理的变体，平均约880行代码）以及3,904个精选的种子实例（1,953个几何体和1,951个带纹理的实例）。由于212个3DCodeBench任务来自同一生成器家族，因此这些数据均未被纳入基准训练（附录C.1）；(4) 智能体编写的程序，包括949个由编码智能体在执行和渲染验证下合成的Blender Python程序及1,134个Three.js场景（分别源自1,040次和1,389次尝试），此外还有25个多文件结构的Three.js仓库以及覆盖21个类别的1,051个网页动画程序；以及(5) harness生成的引导程序，共15,704个经过执行验证的程序，包含质量等级、检查表判定结果和关卡遥测数据，这些程序显著提升了目标方言在我们微调混合模型中的可执行性（§ C.4）。

paragraphs.en: All fine-tuning runs are conducted with LLaMA-Factory ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) on 4 × NVIDIA H100 4\times\text{NVIDIA H100} ( 80 80 GB) GPUs in bfloat16 precision using gradient checkpointing and sequence packing. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) applies LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) of rank 64 64 ( α = 128 \alpha=128 , dropout 0.05 0.05 ) across all linear projections with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} (or 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} for full-parameter fine-tuning under ZeRO-3 ( Rajbhandari et al., 2020 ) ), a cosine learning-rate schedule, a 5 % 5\% linear warm-up ratio, and a per-device batch size of 1 1 with gradient accumulation of 8 8 ( 4 4 for 27 27 B). Direct Preference Optimization (DPO; Rafailov et al. 2023 ) initializes from the merged SFT checkpoint and trains a rank- 16 16 LoRA ( α = 32 \alpha=32 ) for 2 2 epochs under sigmoid preference loss ( β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 , learning rate 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} ). The sequence context length is set to 8,192 8{,}192 tokens for 9 9 B runs and 4,096 4{,}096 tokens for 27 27 B runs to fit single-device memory bounds under data-parallel training. Evaluation inference uses vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) under greedy decoding or temperature sampling ( T = 0.7 T{=}0.7 ) as specified per experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 所有微调运行均使用 LLaMA-Factory（Zheng 等人，2024）在 4 × NVIDIA H100 80 GB GPU 上以 bfloat16 精度执行，并采用梯度检查点和序列打包技术。 监督微调（SFT）在所有线性投影中应用秩为 64（α = 128，dropout 0.05）的 LoRA（Hu 等人，2021），学习率为 1 × 10⁻⁴（对于 ZeRO-3（Rajbhandari 等人，2020）下的全参数微调，则为 1 × 10⁻⁵），采用余弦学习率调度、5% 的线性预热比例，以及每个设备的批量大小为 1，并配合梯度累积因子为 8（对于 27 B 模型则为 4）。 直接偏好优化（DPO；Rafailov 等人，2023）从合并后的 SFT 检查点初始化，并使用秩为 16 的 LoRA（α = 32）在 sigmoid 偏好损失（β = 0.1，学习率 5 × 10⁻⁶）下训练 2 个周期。 序列上下文长度设为 8,192 个 token（对于 9 B 模型）和 4,096 个 token（对于 27 B 模型），以便在数据并行训练下适应单设备内存限制。 评估推理使用 vLLM（Kwon 等人，2023），具体采用贪心解码或温度采样（T = 0.7），以各实验的指定方式执行。

paragraphs.en: Because LoRA introduces a compact optimizer state, training the 27 27 B model under standard Distributed Data Parallel (DDP) avoids ZeRO-3 parameter all-gather traffic and achieves a 13 × \times higher step throughput ( ≈ 6.2 {\approx}6.2 K vs. ≈ 460 {\approx}460 tokens/s) with standard PyTorch allocator caching. Across 4 × H100 4\times\text{H100} GPUs, 9 9 B LoRA sustains ≈ 17 {\approx}17 K tokens/s (completing the 270 270 K-pair, 293 293 M-token mixture in 4 4 h 46 46 m), while 27 27 B LoRA sustains ≈ 6.2 {\approx}6.2 K tokens/s.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 LoRA 引入了紧凑的优化器状态，在标准分布式数据并行（DDP）下训练 27B 模型可避免 ZeRO-3 的参数全收集流量，并在标准 PyTorch 分配器缓存下实现了 13 倍更高的步骤吞吐量（≈6.2 K vs. ≈460 tokens/s）。 在 4 × H100 GPU 上，9B LoRA 的持续吞吐量为 ≈17 K tokens/s（可在 4 小时 46 分钟内完成包含 270 K 个词对和 293 M 个词元的混合数据集），而 27B LoRA 的持续吞吐量为 ≈6.2 K tokens/s。

paragraphs.en: Training examples are formatted as ShareGPT multi-turn conversations: a system prompt specifying the target dialect and output contract, a user turn containing the natural-language specification, and an assistant turn containing the complete executable program in a fenced code block. Any example whose tokenized conversation exceeds the context window is excluded cleanly rather than truncated, preserving syntactic closure. To guarantee zero train–test leakage, all 212 212 3DCodeBench procedural factories, all 3,904 3{,}904 re-seeded instances derived from those factories, and all per-dialect evaluation splits are strictly held out; no training mixture shares a program or asset identifier with any evaluation task. Table 5 details the exact dialect composition, token volume, and wall-clock training duration for every mixture.
paragraphs.zh: 训练示例采用 ShareGPT 多轮对话的格式：一个指定目标方言和输出契约的系统提示，一个包含自然语言说明的用户回合，以及一个包含完整可执行程序（置于代码块中）的助手回合。 任何经过分词后的对话超出上下文窗口的示例都会被完整排除，而非截断，从而保持句法上的完整性。 为确保训练集与测试集之间完全无数据泄露，全部 212 个 212 个 3DCodeBench 过程化工厂、由此类工厂生成的全部 3,904 个 3{,}904 个重新随机初始化的实例，以及所有按方言划分的评估子集均被严格保留；训练数据中没有任何程序或资源标识符与评估任务共享。 表 5 详细列出了每种混合数据集的确切方言构成、令牌数量及实际训练时长。

paragraphs.en: Figure 15 demonstrates smooth, stable convergence across all three regimes: no logged step exceeds 1.3 × 1.3\times the trailing 20 20 -step moving average, and all runs are entirely free of instability or divergence spikes. Rapid initial adaptation occurs within the first quarter of the epoch—reducing cross-entropy from ≈ 0.60 {\approx}0.60 to 0.30 0.30 (Arm A) and 0.36 0.36 (Arms B and C)—followed by steady refinement to terminal smoothed losses of 0.274 0.274 (Arm A), 0.314 0.314 (Arm B), and 0.292 0.292 (Arm C), with Arm A stabilizing across the second half of the epoch ( 0.277 0.277 at mid-epoch to 0.274 0.274 at completion). Together, the three arms highlight two complementary operating regimes of 3DCodeVerse -2M: Arm C ( 293 293 K unique instruction–program pairs, 647 647 steps) offers high sample efficiency for rapid adaptation, achieving a lower terminal loss than Arm B in one quarter of the optimization steps, whereas Arm A ( 1.99 1.99 M rows, 4,322 4{,}322 steps) leverages multi-caption and pass-level shader views to reinforce cross-representation alignment, achieving the lowest loss both at matched step budgets ( 0.275 0.275 vs. 0.316 0.316 at step 2,490 2{,}490 ) and at full convergence ( 0.274 0.274 ).
paragraphs.zh: 图 15 展示了三种模式下的平滑、稳定收敛：没有任何记录步骤超过后 20 步移动平均值的 1.3 × 1.3 倍，且所有运行完全不存在不稳定性或发散尖峰。 在首个周期季度内发生了快速的初始适应——交叉熵从约 0.60 降至 0.30（A 组）和 0.36（B、C 组），随后逐步优化至最终的平滑损失值：A 组为 0.274，B 组为 0.314，C 组为 0.292；其中 A 组在周期后半段保持稳定（从周期中点的 0.277 降至结束时的 0.274）。 这三个组共同揭示了 3DCodeVerse -2M 的两种互补运行模式：C 组（29.3 万条唯一指令-程序对，647 步）提供了高样本效率以实现快速适应，在优化步骤的四分之一时间内实现了低于 B 组的最终损失；而 A 组（199 万行，4,322 步）则利用多描述符和通级着色器视图来加强跨表示对齐，在匹配步数预算时（2,490 步处，0.275 对比 0.316）以及完全收敛时均实现了最低损失（0.274）。

sents.en: Figure 15 demonstrates smooth, stable convergence across all three regimes: no logged step exceeds 1.3 × 1.3\times the trailing 20 20 -step moving average, and all runs are entirely free of instability or divergence spikes.

sents.en: Rapid initial adaptation occurs within the first quarter of the epoch—reducing cross-entropy from ≈ 0.60 {\approx}0.60 to 0.30 0.30 (Arm A) and 0.36 0.36 (Arms B and C)—followed by steady refinement to terminal smoothed losses of 0.274 0.274 (Arm A), 0.314 0.314 (Arm B), and 0.292 0.292 (Arm C), with Arm A stabilizing across the second half of the epoch ( 0.277 0.277 at mid-epoch to 0.274 0.274 at completion).

paragraphs.en: For open-model evaluations (§ 5.2 ), generated responses pass through a deterministic code extractor that strips reasoning blocks, collects fenced code blocks (including trailing unterminated blocks), and ranks candidates by dialect markers, fence annotations, and AST syntactic validity. This extraction step is essential for pretrained reasoning checkpoints: with thinking enabled, 52 52 of 212 212 responses from the zero-shot 27 27 B model omit markdown fences and 74 74 place auxiliary snippets after the main program, whereas fine-tuned models adhere strictly to the single-block output contract ( 100 % 100\% single-fence compliance). Extracted programs execute inside the dialect’s pinned runtime under a 300 300 s timeout. Resulting meshes are exported to GLB, centred at the origin, normalized to unit maximum extent, uniformly sampled at 10,000 10{,}000 surface points, and evaluated via symmetric Chamfer- L 2 L_{2} distance and F-score at thresholds τ ∈ { 0.05 , 0.10 } \tau\in\{0.05,0.10\} (taking the best alignment across the four 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} yaw rotations; ground-truth reference scripts self-verify at Chamfer ≈ 0.016 \text{Chamfer}\approx 0.016 and F@0.05 ≈ 1.0 \text{F@0.05}\approx 1.0 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于开放模型评估（§ 5.2），生成的响应会经过一个确定性代码提取器，该提取器会移除推理块、收集带围栏的代码块（包括末尾未终止的块），并根据方言标记、围栏注释和 AST 句法有效性对候选项进行排序。 对于预训练的推理检查点而言，这一提取步骤至关重要：在启用思考模式的情况下，零样本 27 27 B 模型生成的 212 212 个响应中，有 52 52 个未包含 Markdown 围栏，另有 74 74 个将辅助代码片段置于主程序之后；而微调模型则严格遵循单块输出协议（100% 100\% 的单围栏合规性）。 提取出的程序将在该方言指定的运行时环境中执行，并设置 300 300 秒的超时限制。 最终生成的网格将被导出为 GLB 格式，以原点为中心，归一化至单位最大范围，在 10,000 10{,}000 个表面点上进行均匀采样，并通过对称的 Chamfer-L₂ L_{2} 距离和 F-score 在阈值 τ ∈ { 0.05 , 0.10 } \tau\in\{0.05,0.10\} 下进行评估（取四个 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} 偏航旋转中的最佳对齐结果；基准参考脚本的 Chamfer 距离约为 0.016 \text{Chamfer}\approx 0.016，F@0.05 约为 1.0 \text{F@0.05}\approx 1.0）。

paragraphs.en: The 3D object benchmark comprises 100 100 Three.js generation prompts stratified across three specification levels— 21 21 concise ( simple ), 17 17 moderate ( medium ), and 62 62 richly specified ( detailed ) prompts—testing synthesis across varying levels of structural and stylistic complexity without prescribing explicit metric dimensions or part lists. All systems are evaluated under a uniform single-request deliverable protocol : each workflow receives the identical user prompt string and delivers a final executable program, which is rebuilt and scored by our common evaluator. For commercial product baselines such as Claude Design (powered by Claude Opus 5.5), we evaluate its released reference outputs directly in our unified evaluation pipeline without modification.
paragraphs.zh: 该三维对象基准测试包含 100 个基于 Three.js 生成的提示词，这些提示词按三种规格级别分层分布——21 个简洁（简单）提示词、17 个中等（中度）提示词和 62 个规格丰富的（详细）提示词——旨在测试不同结构和风格复杂度水平下的合成能力，而无需规定明确的指标维度或部件列表。 所有系统均按照统一的单次请求交付协议进行评估：每个工作流程都接收完全相同用户提示字符串，并输出一个最终可执行的程序，该程序将由我们的通用评估器重新构建并评分。 对于 Claude Design（由 Claude Opus 5.5 驱动）等商业产品基准，我们直接在统一评估流程中评估其已发布的参考输出，不作任何修改。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Gemini 3.8 Flash and Claude Opus 5.5 against their respective native baselines on the primary 60 60 -prompt benchmark, and evaluate Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-6 Luna, and GPT-6 Astra on a balanced 30 30 -prompt subset ( 10 10 prompts per specification level). Each native baseline (Table 13 ) synthesizes code in a single pass using its standard coding-agent backend (high reasoning effort for Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5; medium effort for GPT-6 Astra; direct API for Gemini 3.8 Flash), whereas 3DCodeVerse Harness wraps the identical backbone model with structured planning, spatial tools, and automated verification. This paired design directly isolates the end-to-end gain of the 3DCodeVerse Harness workflow for a fixed backbone model, with token telemetry and API-equivalent cost reported alongside quality metrics (Table 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在主要的 60 个提示词基准测试上，将 Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Claude Opus 5.5 与其各自的原始基线模型进行了对比评估；同时，在平衡的 30 个提示词子集（每个规范级别包含 10 个提示词）上，对 Claude Sonnet 5、GPT-6 Luna 和 GPT-6 Astra 进行了评估。 每个原始基线模型（表 13）都通过其标准的编码智能体后端一次性生成代码（Claude Opus 5.5 和 Sonnet 5 需要较高的推理努力；GPT-6 Astra 需要中等努力；Gemini 3.8 Flash 则直接调用 API），而 3DCodeVerse Harness 则是将相同的骨干模型与结构化规划、空间工具和自动化验证相结合。 这种配对设计能够直接分离出 3DCodeVerse Harness 工作流程在固定骨干模型上的端到端增益，同时报告了令牌遥测数据和与 API 等效的成本（表 7）。

paragraphs.en: The single-request protocol prohibits human-in-the-loop intervention: each system receives one user prompt with zero subsequent human edits or manual candidate cherry-picking, while permitting autonomous internal tool calls and verification passes. Our primary object benchmark evaluates single-round harness execution ( T = 0 T=0 in the notation of § 4 ), retaining the initial planned generation, interactive tool use, automated build repair, and final verification (using Gemini 3.8 Flash as planner and Gemini 3.1 Pro as in-loop judge for the Flash runs). Multi-round studies ( T = 4 T=4 ) extend this autonomous loop with up to four closed-loop refinement rounds and automated post-run output selection under the same single user request.
paragraphs.zh: 单次请求协议禁止人工干预：每个系统仅接收一条用户提示，且不允许后续的人工编辑或手动挑选候选结果，但允许自主进行内部工具调用和验证流程。 我们的主要对象基准测试评估单轮执行流程（在 §4 的记法中为 T = 0），保留初始计划生成的内容、交互式工具使用、自动化构建修复以及最终验证（在 Flash 运行中，使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 作为规划器，Gemini 3.1 Pro 作为循环内的评判者）。 多轮研究（T = 4）在此自主循环基础上增加了最多四轮闭环优化，并在同一用户请求下实现自动化运行后的输出选择。

paragraphs.en: All Judge Scores and VLM Preferences reported in § 5 are produced by a single frozen evaluation pipeline that applies the judgment architecture and track rubrics of Appendix A.4 independently of the generation workflow under test. Each delivered program is rebuilt from scratch in its pinned runtime, with failed builds scored zero, to extract geometric measurements, connectivity or kinematic-sweep telemetry, and canonical multi-view renders (fourteen shaded views plus clay views for objects, multi-pose sweeps for articulated mechanisms, authored and orbital views at two timestamps for scenes, and sampled frame sheets for graphics); Gemini 3.1 Pro then scores it three times. Three safeguards decouple evaluation from in-loop refinement: (1) clean-room rebuild and blind prompting , scoring every artifact against the raw user prompt and a prompt-derived checklist alone, with all harness-generated plans, internal checklists, and refinement histories stripped; (2) deterministic geometric caps , bounding scores via exact mesh connectivity and kinematic checks independent of VLM perception (Eq. 5 ); and (3) multi-metric validation , pairing Judge Scores with SigLIP-2 similarity and blind human pairwise preferences (§ 5 ), which consistently corroborate the rubric gains across all four tracks.
paragraphs.zh: § 5 中报告的所有法官评分和 VLM 偏好均通过一个单一的冻结评估流程生成，该流程独立于正在测试的生成工作流程，应用了附录 A.4 中的判断架构和赛道评分标准。 每个交付的程序都会在其固定的运行时环境中从头重建，失败的构建将被计为零分，以便提取几何测量值、连通性或运动学扫描遥测数据，以及标准的多视图渲染（物体包含十四种着色视图加黏土视图，可动机构包含多姿态扫描，场景包含两个时间戳下的作者视图和轨道视图，图形则包含采样帧表）；随后 Gemini 3.1 Pro 会对其进行三次评分。 三项保障措施将评估与循环内的优化相分离：（1）洁净室重建与盲提示，即仅根据原始用户提示和从提示派生出的检查清单对每个成果进行评分，同时移除所有由测试框架生成的计划、内部检查清单和优化历史；（2）确定性几何限制，通过精确的网格连通性和独立于 VLM 感知的运动学检查来限定评分（公式 5）；以及（3）多指标验证，将法官评分与 SigLIP-2 相似性度量和盲测的人类成对偏好（§ 5）相结合，这些结果在所有四个赛道中均一致证实了评分标准的提升。

paragraphs.en: Both human and VLM pairwise evaluations present the original user prompt alongside anonymized multi-view renders captured under matched camera poses, framing, and resolution. Evaluators judge overall preference on prompt adherence, structural plausibility, and visual craftsmanship, with ties counted as half a win; VLM preference additionally requires agreement across both presentation orders (§ A.4 ). Human evaluations randomize left/right presentation order across a fixed, pre-registered prompt subset shared by all compared systems, with prompt-level bootstrap confidence intervals clustering repeated ratings at the task level. In end-to-end preference reporting, a valid executable artifact wins against a failed build and two failed builds tie, while conditional preference over mutually executing pairs is tracked alongside execution rate; transient provider outages are excluded from win/loss tallies.
paragraphs.zh: 人类和 VLM 的成对评估均将原始用户提示与在匹配相机姿态、构图和分辨率下捕获的去标识化多视角渲染图并列呈现。 评估者从提示遵循度、结构合理性及视觉工艺方面判断整体偏好，平局计为半个胜利；VLM 偏好还需在两种呈现顺序上达成一致（§ A.4）。 人类评估在所有受比较系统中共享的固定预注册提示子集上随机化左右呈现顺序，任务层级下重复评分的提示级自助置信区间会聚集在一起。 在端到端偏好报告中，有效的可执行产物优于构建失败的产物，两个构建失败的产物则视为平局；同时还会记录相互执行的对偶之间的条件偏好及其执行率；临时性的提供者中断不计入胜负统计。

paragraphs.en: Tables 6 – 8 report paired score comparisons and 95 % 95\% Student- t t confidence intervals across objects, scenes, and procedural graphics (where W/L/T tallies the signs of per-prompt score differences). On the 60 60 -prompt object benchmark—which concentrates heavily on complex specifications ( 52 52 detailed, 4 4 medium, and 4 4 simple prompts)— 3DCodeVerse Harness lifts Gemini 3.8 Flash by + 25.3 +25.3 points ( 86.6 86.6 vs. 61.3 61.3 , winning 56 56 of 60 60 prompts) and outperforms Claude Design by + 49.2 +49.2 points ( 59 59 – 1 1 W/L/T), even surpassing the native Claude Opus 5.5 baseline by + 9.4 +9.4 points ( 86.6 86.6 vs. 77.2 77.2 ). These gains generalize across tracks (Table 8 ): 3DCodeVerse Harness yields large improvements on procedural graphics for GPT-6 Astra ( + 30.4 +30.4 points, 10 10 – 1 1 W/L/T), Gemini 3.8 Flash ( + 27.2 +27.2 , 10 10 – 1 1 ), and GPT-6 Luna ( + 6.8 +6.8 , 8 8 – 3 3 ), as well as on 3D scenes for Flash ( + 19.4 +19.4 , 9 9 – 1 1 ) and Luna ( + 14.6 +14.6 , 7 7 – 0 0 ). For Claude Sonnet 5 under single-round ( T = 0 T=0 ) execution, 3DCodeVerse Harness wins the majority of graphics prompts ( 6 6 – 5 5 W/L/T) and improves uncapped scene quality ( Δ ​ S vis = + 2.8 \Delta S_{\mathrm{vis}}=+2.8 ), while overall mean scores reflect strict deterministic gate caps applied to outlier frames prior to multi-round refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 表6–8报告了跨对象、场景和过程图形（其中W/L/T统计了每次提示得分差异的符号）的成对得分比较以及95%的学生t置信区间。 在包含60个提示的对象基准测试中——该测试高度集中于复杂规格（52个详细提示、4个中等提示和4个简单提示）——3DCodeVerse Harness使Gemini 3.8 Flash的得分提升了+25.3分（86.6 vs. 61.3，在60个提示中赢得56个），并比Claude Design高出+49.2分（59–1 W/L/T），甚至超过了原生Claude Opus 5.5基准线+9.4分（86.6 vs. 77.2）。 这些提升跨越不同赛道均有效（表8）：3DCodeVerse Harness在GPT-6 Astra的过程图形任务中带来了显著改进（+30.4分，10–1 W/L/T），在Gemini 3.8 Flash中提升了+27.2分（10–1），在GPT-6 Luna中提升了+6.8分（8–3）；同时，在Flash的3D场景任务中提升了+19.4分（9–1），在Luna中提升了+14.6分（7–0）。 对于Claude Sonnet 5的单轮执行（T = 0），3DCodeVerse Harness在多数图形提示中获胜（6–5 W/L/T），并提升了无上限场景质量（Δ Svis = +2.8），而整体平均得分反映了在多轮优化前对异常帧施加了严格的确定性限制。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 reports execution rates and per-prompt token consumption across completed generation attempts (valuing CLI sessions at standard API list prices and excluding post-run evaluation calls; Claude Design is evaluated directly from its released reference programs). Wrapping Gemini 3.8 Flash in 3DCodeVerse Harness raises execution reliability from 93.3 % 93.3\% to 100.0% . Crucially, because our modular workspace and stable tool schemas preserve prefix structure across agent turns, 93.9 % 93.9\% of harness input tokens ( 19,551.8 19{,}551.8 k of 20,816.0 20{,}816.0 k) are served from low-cost prompt cache . At an average cost of $3.31 per object, test-time closed-loop verification enables a lightweight Flash backbone to achieve an 86.6 86.6 Judge Score—substantially outperforming both single-pass Claude Opus 5.5 ( 77.2 77.2 ) and Claude Design ( 37.4 37.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表 7 报告了已完成生成尝试的执行率以及每个提示词消耗的令牌数（CLI 会话按标准 API 列表价格计算，且不包括运行后的评估调用；Claude Design 则直接基于其发布的参考程序进行评估）。 将 Gemini 3.8 Flash 封装在 3DCodeVerse Harness 中，可将执行可靠性从 93.3% 提升至 100.0%。 关键在于，由于我们的模块化工作空间和稳定的工具模式能够在智能体轮次间保留前缀结构，因此 93.9% 的 Harness 输入令牌（20,816.0k 中的 19,551.8k）均来自低成本的提示词缓存。 以每个对象平均 3.31 美元的成本计算，测试时的闭环验证使轻量级的 Flash 骨干模型能够取得 86.6 的 Judge Score——显著优于单次通过的 Claude Opus 5.5（77.2）和 Claude Design（37.4）。

Across repeated evaluations of fixed artifacts, the VLM judge exhibits a standard deviation of only σ judge = 0.030 \sigma_{\mathrm{judge}}=0.030 for Gemini 3.1 Pro ( 0.083 0.083 for Gemini 3.8 Flash) on a [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] scale, confirming that measurement noise is an order of magnitude smaller than the system-level gains reported in § 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 在附录 13 的辅助研究中，每件人工制品都在与两个独立评审样本相匹配的条件下被重新构建、渲染和评分。 在对固定人工制品进行重复评估时，VLM 评审员在 [0,1] 量表上的标准差仅为 σjudge = 0.030 \sigma_{\mathrm{judge}}=0.030（Gemini 3.1 Pro 为 0.083，Gemini 3.8 Flash 为 0.083），这证实了测量噪声比第 5 节中报告的系统级增益小一个数量级。

sents.en: Across repeated evaluations of fixed artifacts, the VLM judge exhibits a standard deviation of only σ judge = 0.030 \sigma_{\mathrm{judge}}=0.030 for Gemini 3.1 Pro ( 0.083 0.083 for Gemini 3.8 Flash) on a [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] scale, confirming that measurement noise is an order of magnitude smaller than the system-level gains reported in § 5 .

paragraphs.en: Independent generation runs on open-ended prompts naturally explore diverse structural decompositions: in an A/A study across six paired runs with early pass stopping (Table 9 ; σ Δ = 0.202 \sigma_{\Delta}=0.202 ), as well as a 12 12 -pair articulated study with a fixed plan ( Δ ¯ = − 0.046 \bar{\Delta}=-0.046 , σ Δ = 0.225 \sigma_{\Delta}=0.225 , 2 ​ SE = ± 0.130 2\,\text{SE}=\pm 0.130 ), a single prompt may be realized either as a compact monolithic mesh ( 1 1 part, 4,796 4{,}796 triangles) or as a fine-grained multi-part assembly ( 10 10 parts, 61,340 61{,}340 triangles). This structural diversity motivates two core design choices in our work: (1) within 3DCodeVerse Harness, best-of- N N candidate initialization and multi-round refinement (§ A.5 ) hedge against single-rollout topological variance; and (2) in our experimental design, while full-workflow gains of + 0.15 +0.15 to + 0.49 +0.49 are cleanly resolved on 30 30 – 60 60 paired prompts, fine-grained infrastructure optimizations are evaluated directly via high-power event-level telemetry across hundreds to thousands of invocations (§ C.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 独立生成过程在开放式提示下会自然地探索多样的结构分解方式：在一项包含六个成对运行并采用早期终止策略的 A/A 研究中（表 9；σ Δ = 0.202 \sigma_{\Delta}=0.202），以及一项采用固定计划的 12 个成对样本的详细研究中（Δ ¯ = − 0.046 \bar{\Delta}=-0.046，σ Δ = 0.225 \sigma_{\Delta}=0.225，2 ​ SE = ± 0.130 2\,\text{SE}=\pm 0.130），单个提示既可以被实现为一个紧凑的整体网格（1 个部分，4,796 个三角形），也可以实现为一个精细的多部件组装结构（10 个部分，61,340 个三角形）。 这种结构多样性促使我们在工作中做出了两个核心设计选择：(1) 在 3DCodeVerse Harness 中，通过“N 个候选中的最佳”初始化和多轮优化（§ A.5），以应对单次运行带来的拓扑变化；(2) 在我们的实验设计中，尽管完整工作流在 30 至 60 个成对提示上的增益（+ 0.15 到 + 0.49）已得到清晰验证，但精细的基础设施优化则是通过数百到数千次调用中的高功率事件级遥测数据直接评估的（§ C.5）。
