paragraphs.en: Table 10 reports per-dialect execution rates and geometric fidelity (F@0.05 and DINOv2-L similarity) across all fine-tuned checkpoints under the evaluation protocol of Table 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 表10报告了在所有微调检查点上，依据表2中的评估协议所测得的每种方言的执行率以及几何保真度（F@0.05和DINOv2-L相似度）。

paragraphs.en: Zero-shot Qwen3.5-9B executes 0/212 3DCodeBench tasks: 165 165 of 212 212 scripts fail immediately on deprecated scene-clearing operators, and patching that single call lifts execution only to 4 / 212 4/212 because of wider Blender 5.0 API drift. After fine-tuning, 9B execution on the held-out Blender suite reaches 93.2% , matching the 96 / 103 96/103 pass rate of the reference scripts themselves, and F@0.05 rises from 0.000 0.000 to 0.328 0.328 on 3DCodeBench and from 0.008 0.008 to 0.725 0.725 on Blender. On Qwen3.8-27B, fine-tuning nearly doubles unconditional F@0.05, from 0.214 0.214 to 0.374 on 3DCodeBench ( + 74.8 % +74.8\% relative) and from 0.439 0.439 to 0.798 on Blender ( + 81.8 % +81.8\% ); whereas the zero-shot checkpoint succeeds only on the easiest half of prompts (conditional F@0.05 of 0.420 0.420 ), the fine-tuned model executes an additional 41.0 % 41.0\% of tasks while keeping conditional F@0.05 at 0.397 0.397 – 0.424 0.424 . The 104 104 K mixture, which adds execution-verified bootstrap programs and balances dialects, further lifts GLSL compilation to 73.0% ( + 16.0 +16.0 pp) and Three.js execution to 92.5% ( + 20.0 +20.0 pp).
paragraphs.zh: Zero-shot Qwen3.5-9B 执行了 0/212 个 3DCodeBench 任务：在 212 个脚本中，有 165 个因弃用的场景清除操作符而立即失败；仅修复这一处调用后，执行成功率也仅提升至 4/212，因为 Blender 5.0 API 存在更广泛的变动。 经过微调后，9B 模型在预留的 Blender 套件上的执行成功率为 93.2%，与参考脚本本身的 96/103（即 96%）通过率相当；在 3DCodeBench 上，F@0.05 从 0.000 提升至 0.328，在 Blender 上则从 0.008 提升至 0.725。 对于 Qwen3.8-27B，微调使无条件 F@0.05 几乎翻倍：在 3DCodeBench 上从 0.214 提升至 0.374（相对提升 +74.8%），在 Blender 上从 0.439 提升至 0.798（相对提升 +81.8%）；而零样本检查点仅能成功处理最简单的一半提示（条件 F@0.05 为 0.420），微调后的模型则额外执行了 41.0% 的任务，同时保持条件 F@0.05 在 0.397–0.424 的区间内。 包含经验证可执行的引导程序并平衡了不同语法的 104K 混合模型，进一步将 GLSL 编译成功率提升至 73.0%（+16.0 个百分点），并将 Three.js 执行成功率提升至 92.5%（+20.0 个百分点）。

paragraphs.en: We construct preference pairs by sampling multiple completions per training prompt and ranking them along three verifiable axes— execution success (running vs. failing scripts), geometric fidelity (highest vs. lowest F@0.05 with Δ ​ F ≥ 0.15 \Delta\text{F}\geq 0.15 ), and sequence termination —and optimize the merged SFT checkpoints with DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) (Tables 11 and 12 ; mixture specifications in Table 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过为每个训练提示采样多个补全结果，并沿三个可验证的维度对其进行排序来构建偏好对——执行成功（脚本运行成功与失败）、几何保真度（F@0.05 最高值与最低值，且 Δ F ≥ 0.15 \Delta\text{F}\geq 0.15），以及序列终止——然后使用 DPO（Rafailov 等人，2023）优化合并后的 SFT 检查点（表 11 和表 12；混合模型规格见表 5）。

paragraphs.en: Each preference signal targets a distinct aspect of code generation quality: (1) Execution-feedback DPO substantially increases single-sample reliability and multi-sample coverage: on the 9B ( 5.2 5.2 K) checkpoint, two rounds of execution DPO lift greedy 3DCodeBench execution from 75.0 % 75.0\% to 96.2% and raise four-seed union pass@4 ( T = 0.7 T{=}0.7 ) from 91.0 % 91.0\% to 99.1% (Table 12 ). On the flagship 27B ( 104 104 K) checkpoint, execution DPO preserves top 3DCodeBench execution ( 92.9% at T = 0.7 T{=}0.7 ) while achieving the highest overall geometric fidelity on both 3DCodeBench (F@0.05 of 0.374 ) and Blender ( 93.2% execution, 0.798 F@0.05) and lifting OpenSCAD execution by + 18.0 +18.0 pp (from 72.0 % 72.0\% to 90.0% ; Table 10 ). (2) Geometry-feedback DPO directly refines 3D shape fidelity once execution is saturated: on the 9B ( 270 270 K) checkpoint, it lifts conditional F@0.05 from 0.387 0.387 to 0.403 while achieving a 98.1 % 98.1\% pass@4 execution rate (Table 12 ). (3) Termination-feedback DPO eliminates repetitive brace-closing loops under greedy decoding. Pairing non-terminating greedy outputs with the model’s shortest valid completion for the same training prompt across two lightweight DPO rounds ( 1,779 1{,}779 and 478 478 pairs) compresses mean OpenSCAD output length from 30,163 30{,}163 to 2,884 2{,}884 tokens and drives greedy execution from 8.0 % 8.0\% to 86.0% ( + 78.0 +78.0 pp) on OpenSCAD, from 59.0 % 59.0\% to 89.5% ( + 30.5 +30.5 pp) on GLSL, and from 79.2 % 79.2\% to 84.9% on 3DCodeBench .
paragraphs.zh: 每个偏好信号都针对代码生成质量的特定方面：（1）执行反馈 DPO 显著提升了单样本可靠性和多样本覆盖范围。在 9B（5.2 5.2 K）检查点上，两轮执行 DPO 将贪婪 3DCodeBench 的执行率从 75.0 % 75.0\% 提升至 96.2%，并将四种子联合 pass@4（T = 0.7 T{=}0.7）从 91.0 % 91.0\% 提升至 99.1%（表 12）。 在旗舰 27B（104 104 K）检查点上，执行 DPO 保持了顶级的 3DCodeBench 执行表现（T = 0.7 T{=}0.7 时达 92.9%），同时实现了 3DCodeBench（F@0.05 为 0.374）和 Blender（93.2% 执行率，F@0.05 为 0.798）上最高的整体几何保真度，并将 OpenSCAD 的执行率提升了 +18.0 +18.0 pp（从 72.0 % 72.0\% 提升至 90.0%；表 10）。 （2）几何反馈 DPO 在执行表现达到饱和后，直接优化了 3D 形状的保真度。在 9B（270 270 K）检查点上，它将条件 F@0.05 从 0.387 0.387 提升至 0.403，同时实现了 98.1 % 98.1\% 的 pass@4 执行率（表 12）。 （3）终止反馈 DPO 消除了贪婪解码过程中重复的括号闭合循环。 将非终止的贪婪输出与模型对相同训练提示的最短有效完成结果进行配对，并通过两轮轻量级 DPO（1,779 1{,}779 和 478 478 对），将 OpenSCAD 输出的平均长度从 30,163 30{,}163 压缩至 2,884 2{,}884 个词元，并使 OpenSCAD 的贪婪执行率从 8.0 % 8.0\% 提升至 86.0%（+78.0 +78.0 pp），GLSL 的执行率从 59.0 % 59.0\% 提升至 89.5%（+30.5 +30.5 pp），3DCodeBench 的执行率从 79.2 % 79.2\% 提升至 84.9%。

paragraphs.en: Comparing single-dialect and multi-dialect training mixtures reveals strong cross-language transfer alongside clear mixture-design principles: (1) Cross-dialect transfer : joint multi-dialect training boosts CadQuery execution to 98.0% , compared with 73.0 % 73.0\% under single-dialect training. (2) Target-dialect upsampling : increasing the Blender share of the 9B mixture from 15 % 15\% to 34 % 34\% (Table 5 , 116 116 K balanced) raises held-out Blender F@0.05 from 0.705 0.705 to 0.816 (with failed builds scored zero) and lifts greedy OpenSCAD execution from 4 % 4\% to 56 % 56\% . (3) Capacity and mixture balance for long-horizon scripts : while isolated fine-tuning of a 9B checkpoint on 280 280 long multi-part Three.js programs approaches the sequence window and induces non-termination, combining balanced multi-dialect supervision with larger capacity in the 27B ( 104 104 K) mixture elevates Three.js execution from 72.5 % 72.5\% to 92.5% (Table 10 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对比单方言和多方言训练混合模型可以发现，存在显著的语言间迁移效果以及明确的混合设计原则：(1) 跨方言迁移：联合多方言训练将 CadQuery 的执行率提升至 98.0%，而单方言训练下仅为 73.0%。 (2) 目标方言上采样：将 9B 混合模型中 Blender 的比例从 15% 提高到 34%（表 5，116K 平衡数据），使保留测试集上的 Blender F@0.05 从 0.705 提升至 0.816（失败构建计分为零），同时使贪婪 OpenSCAD 执行率从 4% 提升至 56%。 (3) 长周期脚本的容量与混合平衡：尽管对 9B 检查点在 280 个长多部分 Three.js 程序上进行单独微调已接近序列窗口限制并导致非终止，但将平衡的多方言监督与 27B（104K）混合模型中的更大容量相结合，使 Three.js 执行率从 72.5% 提升至 92.5%（表 10）。

sents.zh: (2) 目标方言上采样：将 9B 混合模型中 Blender 的比例从 15% 提高到 34%（表 5，116K 平衡数据），使保留测试集上的 Blender F@0.05 从 0.705 提升至 0.816（失败构建计分为零），同时使贪婪 OpenSCAD 执行率从 4% 提升至 56%。

sents.en: (3) Capacity and mixture balance for long-horizon scripts : while isolated fine-tuning of a 9B checkpoint on 280 280 long multi-part Three.js programs approaches the sequence window and induces non-termination, combining balanced multi-dialect supervision with larger capacity in the 27B ( 104 104 K) mixture elevates Three.js execution from 72.5 % 72.5\% to 92.5% (Table 10 ).
sents.zh: (3) 长周期脚本的容量与混合平衡：尽管对 9B 检查点在 280 个长多部分 Three.js 程序上进行单独微调已接近序列窗口限制并导致非终止，但将平衡的多方言监督与 27B（104K）混合模型中的更大容量相结合，使 Three.js 执行率从 72.5% 提升至 92.5%（表 10）。

paragraphs.en: Tables 14 and 15 evaluate 3DCodeVerse Harness across five model backbones on challenging object, articulated-mechanism, and shader prompts. Across all five configurations in Table 14 , 3DCodeVerse Harness delivers consistent paired gains of + 15.5 +15.5 to + 52.3 +52.3 points over one-shot generation, achieving 100% execution reliability across every model in Table 15 (compared with 38 % 38\% – 92 % 92\% for one-shot baselines). Within multi-round trajectories, closed-loop refinement boosts mean articulated-object scores from 0.605 0.605 (Round 0 0 ) to 0.789 0.789 (final selected round)—gaining + 0.284 +0.284 on the hardest mechanisms with 58 % 58\% achieving a full rubric pass—and raises GLSL shader scores from 0.712 0.712 to 0.748 0.748 ( 5 / 6 5/6 passing).
paragraphs.zh: 表14和表15评估了3DCodeVerse Harness在五个模型主干架构上处理具有挑战性的对象、可动机械结构和着色器提示时的表现。 在表14的所有五种配置中，3DCodeVerse Harness相比单次生成实现了稳定的成对提升，分数从+15.5到+52.3不等，并且在表15的每个模型中都达到了100%的执行可靠性（而单次生成的基线方法仅为38%–92%）。 在多轮轨迹中，闭环优化将可动对象的平均得分从0.605（第0轮）提升至0.789（最终选定的轮次），在最复杂的机械结构上获得了+0.284的提升，其中58%的样本完全符合评分标准；同时GLSL着色器的得分也从0.712提升至0.748（6分之5通过）。

paragraphs.en: Crucially, the paired comparison in the lower panel of Table 15 demonstrates how harness verification interacts with backbone capability on hard prompts: (1) Bridging model tiers : equipping the lightweight Gemini 3.8 Flash model with 3DCodeVerse Harness raises its mean score from 0.146 0.146 to 0.625 0.625 , matching the frontier GPT-6 Sol one-shot baseline ( 0.603 0.603 ) and winning 5 5 of 8 8 head-to-head prompts. (2) Scaling with frontier backbones : applying 3DCodeVerse Harness to GPT-6 Sol itself pushes performance further to 0.758 ( + 15.5 +15.5 points over Sol one-shot, winning 8 / 8 8/8 prompts against Flash + 3DCodeVerse Harness), showing that closed-loop spatial verification both elevates lightweight models to frontier one-shot quality and unlocks substantially higher ceilings on flagship models.
paragraphs.zh: 关键在于，表 15 下方面板的成对比较展示了 Harness 验证如何与主干模型在复杂提示上的能力相互作用：(1) 跨越模型层级：为轻量级 Gemini 3.8 Flash 模型配备 3DCodeVerse Harness，使其平均得分从 0.146 提升至 0.625，与前沿 GPT-6 Sol 单次提示基线（0.603）相当，并在 8 次直接对抗中赢得 5 次。 (2) 与前沿主干模型协同扩展：将 3DCodeVerse Harness 应用于 GPT-6 Sol 本身，可进一步将其性能提升至 0.758（比 Sol 单次提示高出 15.5 分，在与 Flash + 3DCodeVerse Harness 的对比中赢得全部 8 次提示），这表明闭环空间验证既能将轻量级模型的性能提升至前沿单次提示水平，也能显著释放旗舰模型的性能上限。

paragraphs.en: Complex mechanisms such as scissor lifts, parallel grippers, and synchronized double doors require coordinated multi-joint motion via URDF mimic constraints ( q j = m j ​ q i + b j q_{j}=m_{j}q_{i}+b_{j} ). On ten coupled-linkage prompts evaluated at Round 0 0 ( T = 0 T=0 ), augmenting the planner schema with an explicit coupling field increases valid URDF mimic declarations from 3/10 (30%) to 10/10 (100%) : eight mechanisms correctly reduce to a single independent degree of freedom, and the remaining two appropriately retain secondary degrees of freedom for wheel rotation or mirror tilt. Because Round 0 0 precedes iterative joint-sweep refinement (where both arms begin at comparable initial visual scores, Δ = − 0.006 \Delta=-0.006 ), this ablation highlights a clean architectural division of labour: explicit schema planning guarantees topological and kinematic coupling completeness in Round 0 0 , establishing a valid mechanism graph for subsequent joint-sweep collision refinement (§ A.7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 复杂的机构，如剪刀式升降机、平行夹爪和同步双门，需要通过 URDF mimic 约束（ q j = m j ​ q i + b j q_{j}=m_{j}q_{i}+b_{j} ）实现多关节的协同运动。 在 Round 0 0（ T = 0 T=0 ）评估的十个耦合连杆提示中，通过为规划器方案添加显式耦合字段，有效的 URDF mimic 声明数量从 3/10（30%）增加到 10/10（100%）：八个机构被正确简化为单个独立自由度，而其余两个则适当地保留了用于车轮旋转或镜像倾斜的次要自由度。 由于 Round 0 0 发生在迭代关节扫描优化之前（此时双臂的初始视觉分数相当，Δ = − 0.006 \Delta=-0.006），这一消融研究凸显了清晰的架构分工：显式方案规划确保了 Round 0 0 中拓扑和运动学耦合的完整性，从而为后续的关节扫描碰撞优化（§ A.7 ）建立了有效的机构图。

paragraphs.en: Whereas end-to-end scores resolve workflow gains on 30 30 – 60 60 prompts, individual infrastructure mechanisms are evaluated with event-level telemetry over hundreds to thousands of invocations (Table 17 ). (1) Context-reset plan resampling : when a planner emits a degenerate kinematic hierarchy whose joints reference undeclared links, resetting the context to the original request with the violated schema rule, instead of repairing in-context, cuts the plan-stage failure rate by 6.7 × \times ( 13 / 277 13/277 to 2 / 276 2/276 ; two-sided Fisher’s exact test, p = 0.0067 p=0.0067 ) at negligible per-call cost ($0.0337 vs. $0.0345), and a reset triggered specifically on dangling link references eliminates that failure mode ( 0 / 276 0/276 vs. 3 / 140 3/140 , p = 0.038 p=0.038 ). (2) Verdict–transport decoupling : reporting a valid negative observation, such as a detected collision, as an MCP transport error triggers blind retry loops and, in some agent backends, base64-serialized images; separating semantic verdicts from protocol errors and bounding diagnostic payloads (§ A.3 ) reduces redundant retries by 20 × \times across 3,677 3{,}677 invocations on 14 14 matched prompts, uncached prompt tokens per request by 65% , and median generator cost per round by 40% , while preserving artifact quality ( Δ = + 0.015 \Delta=+0.015 ). (3) Scoped session horizons : across 1,063 1{,}063 sessions ( 30,401 30{,}401 turns), per-turn input grows linearly with depth as input ⁡ ( t ) ≈ 12,364 + 1,822 ​ t \operatorname{input}(t)\approx 12{,}364+1{,}822\,t , so cumulative session tokens scale as n 1.60 n^{1.60} over n n turns; halving turn depth cuts cumulative tokens by 68% and net API cost by 55% after prompt-cache discounts, which motivates the file-disjoint subtree decomposition of § A.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 虽然端到端评分能反映在 30 30 – 60 60 条提示词上的工作流程增益，但各项基础设施机制则是通过数百至数千次调用中的事件级遥测数据进行评估的（表 17）。 （1）上下文重置计划的重新采样：当规划器生成一个退化的运动学层级，其关节引用了未声明的连杆时，将上下文重置为原始请求并附带被违反的模式规则，而不是在上下文中进行修复，可使计划阶段的失败率降低 6.7 × \times（从 13 / 277 13/277 降至 2 / 276 2/276；双侧费希尔精确检验，p = 0.0067 p=0.0067），且每次调用的额外成本可忽略不计（$0.0337 对比 $0.0345）；而专门针对悬空连杆引用触发的重置，则能彻底消除这种失败模式（0 / 276 0/276 对比 3 / 140 3/140，p = 0.038 p=0.038）。 （2）判定与传输的解耦：将有效的负面观察结果（例如检测到的碰撞）报告为 MCP 传输错误，会引发盲目的重试循环，在某些智能体后端甚至会生成 base64 序列化的图像；通过将语义判定与协议错误分离，并限制诊断负载的大小（§ A.3），可在 14 14 条匹配提示词的 3,677 3{,}677 次调用中，将冗余重试次数减少 20 × \times，每请求的未缓存提示词令牌数减少 65%，每轮生成器的平均成本降低 40%，同时仍保持产物质量（Δ = + 0.015 \Delta=+0.015）。 （3）限定范围的会话时程：在 1,063 1{,}063 个会话（共 30,401 30{,}401 轮）中，每轮输入随深度线性增长，满足 \operatorname{input}(t)\approx 12{,}364+1{,}822\,t；因此，累计会话令牌数随 n n 轮次按 n^{1.60} 的规律增长；将轮次深度减半后，在应用提示词缓存折扣后，累计令牌数减少 68%，净 API 成本降低 55%，这也促使了 § A.2 中提出的文件不交叠子树分解方法。

paragraphs.en: Complementing the robotics application in § 6 , we examine how executable 3D code preserves rigid-link structure during robot manipulation compared with a frozen video world-action model, UWM ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Using an articulated microwave asset synthesized by GPT-6 Astra and verified by 3DCodeVerse Harness tooling (passing forward-kinematics, rigid-distance, and hinge-sweep gates across five poses), we instantiate a MuJoCo simulation alongside the native reference asset across two initial contact states and three robot control sequences— contact push , hold , and retreat —yielding 12 12 evaluation cases. Each rollout executes 16 16 matched robot action commands at 20 20 Hz: UWM generates three seeded video rollouts per case ( 36 36 total) from observation history and action commands, whereas code simulation steps the explicit articulated asset directly inside MuJoCo.
paragraphs.zh: 作为第 6 节中机器人应用内容的补充，我们研究了可执行的 3D 代码在机器人操作过程中如何保持刚性连杆结构，并将其与冻结的视频世界动作模型 UWM（Zhu et al., 2025）进行了比较。 我们使用由 GPT-6 Astra 合成并通过 3DCodeVerse Harness 工具验证的铰接式微波炉资产（在五种姿态下通过了正向运动学、刚性距离和铰链扫描检查），在两种初始接触状态和三种机器人控制序列——接触推动、保持和撤退——中，同步运行 MuJoCo 模拟和本地参考资产，从而产生了 12 个评估用例。 每次运行都以 20 Hz 的频率执行 16 条匹配的机器人动作指令：UWM 根据观察历史和动作指令为每个用例生成三个初始化的视频运行（总计 36 个），而代码模拟则直接在 MuJoCo 中逐步推进显式的铰接式资产。

sents.en: Using an articulated microwave asset synthesized by GPT-6 Astra and verified by 3DCodeVerse Harness tooling (passing forward-kinematics, rigid-distance, and hinge-sweep gates across five poses), we instantiate a MuJoCo simulation alongside the native reference asset across two initial contact states and three robot control sequences— contact push , hold , and retreat —yielding 12 12 evaluation cases.
sents.zh: 我们使用由 GPT-6 Astra 合成并通过 3DCodeVerse Harness 工具验证的铰接式微波炉资产（在五种姿态下通过了正向运动学、刚性距离和铰链扫描检查），在两种初始接触状态和三种机器人控制序列——接触推动、保持和撤退——中，同步运行 MuJoCo 模拟和本地参考资产，从而产生了 12 个评估用例。

sents.en: Each rollout executes 16 16 matched robot action commands at 20 20 Hz: UWM generates three seeded video rollouts per case ( 36 36 total) from observation history and action commands, whereas code simulation steps the explicit articulated asset directly inside MuJoCo.
sents.zh: 每次运行都以 20 Hz 的频率执行 16 条匹配的机器人动作指令：UWM 根据观察历史和动作指令为每个用例生成三个初始化的视频运行（总计 36 个），而代码模拟则直接在 MuJoCo 中逐步推进显式的铰接式资产。

paragraphs.en: To measure whether rollouts maintain coherent rigid-part geometry under physical interaction, we apply a calibrated orientation-aware door-and-handle contour detector across all outputs. Calibrated prior to evaluation on 24 24 held-out static renders across six hinge angles and four robot poses, the detector recovers the true hinge angle within 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} on all 20 20 accepted detections and abstains whenever contours degrade or become ambiguous. To isolate latent dynamics drift from autoencoder reconstruction blur, we additionally evaluate a VAE-reconstructed code control by passing every simulator render through UWM’s frozen VAE encoder and decoder. Across all 72 72 evaluated outputs (Table 17 ), both direct code simulation and VAE-reconstructed code renders satisfy the geometric criterion in 12/12 (100%) rollouts, whereas UWM predictions satisfy the criterion in only 7/36 (19.4%) rollouts ( 29 / 36 29/36 fail to preserve assessable door-and-handle contours). Because passing code renders through UWM’s own frozen VAE preserves a 12 / 12 12/12 pass rate, the contour degradation in UWM rollouts stems from latent action dynamics rather than VAE reconstruction limits.
paragraphs.zh: 为了衡量 rollout 在物理交互下是否保持连贯的刚性部件几何结构，我们在所有输出上应用了经过校准且具备方向感知能力的门把手轮廓检测器。 在针对 24 个静态渲染图像（涵盖六个铰链角度和四种机器人姿态）进行评估前进行了校准，该检测器在所有 20 个被接受的检测结果中都能将真实铰链角度恢复至 1° 以内，并在轮廓退化或模糊时选择放弃检测。 为了将潜在动态漂移与自编码器重建造成的模糊区分开来，我们还通过让每个模拟器渲染图像经过 UWM 的冻结 VAE 编码器和解码器，对 VAE 重建的编码控制进行了额外评估。 在所有 72 个被评估的输出中（表 17），直接编码模拟和 VAE 重建编码的渲染结果在全部 12 次 rollout 中均满足几何标准（100%），而 UWM 的预测仅在 7/36 次 rollout 中满足该标准（29/36 次未能保留可评估的门把手轮廓）。 由于将编码渲染结果通过 UWM 自身的冻结 VAE 处理仍能保持 12/12 的通过率，因此 UWM rollout 中的轮廓退化源于潜在动作动态而非 VAE 重建的局限性。

paragraphs.en: Table 17 and Figures 16 – 17 clarify the structural advantage of programmatic 3D assets for embodied simulation. While a static last-frame baseline trivially preserves initial contours ( 12 / 12 12/12 ) by predicting zero motion, pixel-space world models synthesize motion directly in latent space at the cost of frequent contour distortion across random seeds. By contrast, compiling generated 3D code into a physics simulator combines both properties: the simulator enforces exact rigid-body transformations, joint axes, and articulated state transitions over time while maintaining crisp, view-consistent geometry across contact push, hold, and retreat controls.
paragraphs.zh: 表 17 和图 16–17 阐明了程序化 3D 资产在具身模拟中的结构优势。 尽管静态的最后一帧基线通过预测零运动轻而易举地保留了初始轮廓（12 / 12 12/12），但像素空间的世界模型则直接在潜在空间中合成运动，代价是在随机种子下频繁出现轮廓失真。 相比之下，将生成的 3D 代码编译到物理模拟器中结合了两者的特性：模拟器强制执行精确的刚体变换、关节轴和随时间变化的铰接状态转换，同时在接触推动、保持和回撤控制过程中保持清晰且视角一致的几何结构。
